We are looking for a U.S. Customs Assurance Manager. This position is remote.

We are seeking a U.S. Customs Assurance Manager to support U.S. Customs Operations through data analysis, compliance monitoring, reporting, and process improvement. This role combines practical customs knowledge with strong analytical skills to identify risks, improve data quality, strengthen controls, and translate complex trade data into actionable business insights.

The successful candidate will be comfortable investigating issues beyond system-generated results, explaining the regulatory basis for conclusions, and partnering across functions to improve customs compliance and operational performance. You use data and sound customs judgment to uncover risk, explain why an issue occurred, and help build scalable reporting and controls that strengthen U.S. Customs Operations.

You will make an impact by:

  • Develop and maintain customs reports, scorecards, and key performance indicators.
  • Analyze import and broker data to identify entry errors, recurring trends, compliance risks, and improvement opportunities.
  • Perform root-cause analysis and support corrective actions for classification, valuation, country-of-origin, and entry discrepancies.
  • Design or support data validations, exception reporting, and monitoring controls that improve customs data integrity.
  • Support HTS classification reviews, USMCA and other free trade agreement activities, audits, and compliance assessments.
  • Translate analytical findings into clear recommendations for Customs Operations and business stakeholders.
  • Partner with brokers, supply chain, logistics, procurement, finance, technology teams, and other stakeholders to resolve data and process issues.
  • Identify opportunities to automate manual activities and improve reporting, visibility, and operational efficiency.

You’ll win us over by having the following qualifications:

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in International Trade, Supply Chain, Business, Finance, Data Analytics, Information Systems, Logistics, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in customs compliance, customs operations, brokerage, trade analytics, supply chain analytics, or a related field.
  • Working knowledge of U.S. import regulations and customs processes, including entry requirements, HTS classification, valuation, and country-of-origin principles.
  • Demonstrated ability to analyze large datasets, identify anomalies and trends, and communicate findings clearly.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including pivot tables, lookup functions, data validation, and reporting.
  • Strong critical-thinking, problem-solving, organizational, written, and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a cross-functional environment.
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States on a continual and permanent basis without company sponsorship.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Five or more years of progressively responsible experience in customs compliance, customs operations, brokerage, or trade analytics.
  • Hands-on experience applying customs regulations to classification, audit, USMCA or other free trade agreement, origin, valuation, or post-entry activities.
  • Experience creating dashboards, KPIs, scorecards, validations, or automated compliance reports.
  • Proficiency with Tableau, Power BI, Snowflake, SAP, Alteryx, Power Automate, or comparable analytics and automation tools.
  • Experience evaluating broker performance, entry accuracy, compliance trends, and root causes.
  • Experience supporting internal or external audits, corrective-action tracking, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Licensed Customs Broker certification is a plus.

Job.JobTitle: Senior Vice President of Sales, Americas - Grid Software
Job.JobDescription:
Who are we?

Here at Siemens Grid Software, our mission is to accelerate and secure the energy transition in a sustainable and profitable way. And for that we need you! We are paving the way for autonomous grid management, empowering grid operators to accelerate their digital transformation easier, faster, and at scale.

By leaving behind traditional ways of tackling the net zero challenge and embracing the powerful capabilities of software and digital technology, we turn the complexity of grids into competitive advantage. No matter where power comes from or where it goes, we make sure it makes its way at every step.

Join our team, get inspired, and help us re-imagine the world! Transform the everyday with us!

We are seeking an experienced Senior Vice President of Sales for the Americas to lead and grow our regional sales organization across the United States, Canada, and Central and South America — driving revenue for Siemens Grid Software’s software and services portfolio that powers the digital transformation of electric grid operators worldwide. This is a high-visibility leadership role reporting into senior global sales leadership, with direct responsibility for a team of regional Vice Presidents of Sales and full ownership of revenue generation and growth across the Americas.

This is a role based in the United States, with regular travel across the Americas region to engage regional teams, partners, and customers.

You’ll make an impact as you:

  • Connect global strategy to regional execution. Understand and be an active partner in shaping Siemens Grid Software’s global sales strategy, then interpret and translate that strategy into an actionable plan for the Americas — adjusting the approach as needed to fit the realities of the U.S., Canada, and Central and South American markets.
  • Lead a multi-country sales leadership team. Directly manage, coach, and develop Vice Presidents of Sales for the U.S./Canada and Central/South America sub-regions, building a high-performing, accountable leadership bench.
  • Drive revenue generation and growth. Own orders and revenue targets across the Americas, with disciplined forecasting, pipeline management, and consistent quota attainment across all sub-regions.
  • Build executive relationships. Cultivate and personally engage in strategic relationships with C-level and senior executives at TSOs, DSOs, IOUs, and other utility customers to shape and close large, complex, multi-year deals.
  • Champion customer success. Partner with product, delivery, and customer success teams to ensure customers realize measurable value from Siemens Grid Software solutions, driving renewals, expansion, and reference-ability.
  • Develop go-to-market capability. Build and refine sales processes, territory design, compensation plans, and partner/channel strategies suited to the diverse markets across the Americas.
  • Align cross-functionally. Work closely with marketing, product management, delivery, and finance leadership to ensure the Americas sales strategy is fully aligned with global company priorities.
  • Represent Siemens externally. Serve as a visible, credible executive voice for Siemens Grid Software at industry events, customer forums, and analyst engagements across the region.

You’ll win us over by having the following qualifications:

Basic qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree required; MBA or advanced degree in business, engineering, or a related field preferred.
  • 12+ years of progressive sales leadership experience in enterprise software/SaaS, including 5+ years managing sales leaders (VP or Director-level) across multiple countries or regions.
  • Proven track record of consistently meeting or exceeding multi-million-dollar revenue/orders targets in a complex, solution-selling environment.
  • Solid knowledge of the power utilities/grid industry, including familiarity with electric utilities, ISOs/RTOs, transmission and distribution organizations, and grid technologies domains such as EMS, DMS, ADMS, or grid planning.
  • Demonstrated experience selling enterprise software and services solutions (not just hardware/products) into utility or critical-infrastructure customers.
  • Proven experience engaging directly with C-level executives at electrical utility companies; existing relationships with C-level utility leaders across the Americas are strongly preferred.
  • Experience building and leading distributed, multicultural sales teams across the U.S., Canada, and Latin America, with a strong understanding of regional market dynamics.
  • Ability to travel 50% (domestic and international) to support customers and regional teams across the Americas.
  • Strong communication skills in business-proficient English and interculturally competent; Spanish and/or Portuguese language skills are a bonus, though not required, given the Central/South America scope.
  • Adaptable to new tasks, solutions, and customer needs.
  • Must be legally authorized for employment in the United States; Siemens is not able to sponsor or transfer employment-based visas for this role, now or in the future.

Good fit if you have 15+ years in commodity risk management, deep power and natural gas expertise, strong quantitative skills, and experience leading complex projects.

Full job description

Who are we?

Here at Siemens Grid Software, our mission is to accelerate and secure the energy transition in a sustainable and profitable way. And for that we need you! We are paving the way for autonomous grid management empowering grid operators to accelerate their digital transformation easier, faster, and at scale.

By leaving behind traditional ways of tackling the net zero challenge and embracing the powerful capabilities of software and digital technology, we turn the complexity of grids into competitive advantage. No matter where power comes from or where it goes, we make sure it makes its way at every step.

Grid Software’s Power Technologies International (PTI) Energy Business Advisory team is paving the way for businesses to navigate complexity, drive growth, and shape the future in an evolving landscape. Our comprehensive services provide solutions in strategic planning, risk management, operational efficiency, tailored market studies, M&A support, and infrastructure development.

Find out how Siemens Grid Software is decoding the future of energy.

Join our team, get inspired, and help us re-imagine the world! Transform the everyday with us

We are looking for a Risk Management Consulting Specialist with a strong background in the energy industry. Our team seeks someone with expertise in portfolio management, implementing hedging strategies, and trading or procuring power, gas, and renewable energy credits. The Risk Management Consulting Specialist will be proficient in standard methodologies for risk assessment and crafting risk programs.

This is a remote position in the U.S.

This opportunity offers remote flexibility and a collaborative culture built on honesty, accountability, empowerment, and autonomy. You will have opportunities to shape client strategies, develop colleagues, and grow the practice.

You’ll make an impact as you:

  • Lead client discussions, identify business needs, explain trade-offs, and recommend action.
  • Develop procurement, hedging, and portfolio-risk strategies for power, natural gas, refined products, and other related exposures.
  • Connect market fundamentals and portfolio risks to client objectives, budgets, and operational constraints.
  • Design and review risk analyses, including VaR, cash-flow-at-risk, stress testing, and hedge effectiveness.
  • Develop risk policies, governance frameworks, and limits; support implementation of approved strategies.
  • Translate client needs into ETRM analyses, workflows, controls, and reporting.
  • Lead engagements and workstreams, owning analytical quality, scope, budgets, and deadlines.
  • Turn insights on emerging commodity risks into recommendations, presentations, and new services.
  • Build client relationships, identify opportunities, develop proposals, and help win profitable engagements.
  • Mentor consultants, delegate effectively, and strengthen analytical and client-facing skills.
  • Improve delivery through automation, reusable tools, and standardized methods.
  • Align client and internal stakeholders, contributing as a hands-on specialist or project director.

You’ll win us over by having the following qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, economics, finance, statistics, physics, mathematics, or a related analytical field.
  • 15+ years in commodity risk management, as well as energy trading, portfolio management, procurement, or related consulting.
  • Substantial power and/or natural gas risk experience, including hedging strategy and implementation. (Commodity risk management required.)
  • Strong quantitative foundations demonstrated through hands-on modeling, analysis, or validation during your career.
  • Ability to challenge methods, data, and assumptions and explain their commercial implications.
  • Experience developing risk programs for physical and contractual energy portfolios.
  • Ability to explain technical concepts and deliver actionable recommendations to senior stakeholders.
  • Experience leading complex projects, managing priorities, and owning delivery quality.
  • Experience mentoring colleagues and reviewing analytical work.
  • Willingness and ability to travel up to 20%.
  • Ability to work in the U.S. without current or future employer-sponsored work authorization.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master’s degree in finance, financial engineering, quantitative finance, economics, or a related field.
  • Consulting or external client-advisory experience.
  • Success building client relationships, developing proposals, and winning engagements.
  • Entrade or other energy trading and risk management platform experience.
  • Proficiency with tools such as Python, SQL, R, or advanced Excel.
  • Experience across energy markets and client types, including utilities, municipalities, large users, and suppliers.
  • Experience developing thought leadership, presenting to executives, or creating advisory services.

Job.JobDescription:

About this job

Lead Siemens USA's growth strategy for the Life Sciences vertical market, connecting global priorities with US customer needs. Serve as primary coordinator across Siemens businesses and the Life Sciences ecosystem to align strategies, capture opportunities, and strengthen market position.

Good fit if you have 10+ years in Life Sciences (pharma, biotech, medical devices), understand regulatory frameworks like FDA and GMP, and know digital transformation technologies including MES and digital twins.

Full job description

At Siemens, we empower our customers by combining the real and digital worlds to improve how we live, work, and move today and for future generations. Our people are at the center of everything we do, driving innovation, collaboration, and sustainable growth.

We are looking for a US Head of Vertical Market – Life Sciences.

The One Tech Company transformation is creating new opportunities for Siemens to bring together innovative technologies, deep industry expertise, and cross-business collaboration to serve customers in more meaningful ways. The US Head of Vertical Market – Life Sciences will help lead this effort across one of Siemens' most important strategic markets. This role will serve as a key connector across businesses, stakeholders, and customers, helping to align market strategies, unlock growth opportunities, and strengthen Siemens' position throughout the Life Sciences ecosystem.

You'll Make an Impact By

  • Leading Siemens USA’s growth strategy and business plan for the assigned Vertical, aligning global Vertical priorities with US market trends, customer needs, competitive insights, and the One Tech Company ambition.
  • Serving as the US representative for the global Vertical and as the primary local coordination point for Siemens US leadership, the global Vertical organization, Siemens businesses, customers, partners, and other internal and external stakeholders.
  • Operating as an integrated member of the global Vertical organization, with a solid-line reporting relationship within Siemens US and a strong dotted-line relationship into the global Vertical organization.
  • Leading strategic opportunity capture and pursuits by mobilizing Siemens businesses, orchestrating cross-business resources and executive sponsorship, and creating a coordinated One Tech Company experience for customers.
  • Building and leading the US Vertical community across businesses, functions, sales teams, regions, and channels to align priorities, strengthen collaboration, and accelerate growth.
  • Developing and executing the US Vertical business plan, including market priorities, target segments, focus accounts, strategic opportunities, ecosystem partnerships, and growth initiatives.
  • Determining the localization of global Vertical strategy, including US go-to-market approaches, account focus, sales motions, channel and partner strategies, and coordinated marketing execution.
  • Building trusted executive customer and ecosystem relationships, representing Siemens in the market, and expanding Siemens’ influence through industry engagement, advocacy, and thought leadership.
  • Acting as the voice of the US customer, market, and industry by translating insights into enterprise action, portfolio priorities, solution development, investment choices, enablement needs, and business results.
  • Leveraging global Vertical leadership, market development, architecture, subject matter experts, and other supporting capabilities to accelerate local strategy, opportunity development, solution design, and execution.
  • Identifying cross-business synergies, portfolio and capability needs, solution gaps, resource requirements, and investment priorities, and aligning the appropriate Siemens businesses and functions to address them.
  • Ensuring relevant Siemens capabilities—including sales enablement, marketing, financing, consulting, architecture, and other supporting functions—are engaged in the right opportunities and implemented effectively.

Required Qualifications

  • 10+ years of Life Sciences industry experience and knowledge, including pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, medical devices, and healthcare, with an understanding of industry customers, market dynamics, supply chain complexities, regulatory requirements, and digital transformation trends.
  • Deep understanding of pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device, and CDMO manufacturing environments and the business, operational, quality, and technology priorities shaping these markets.
  • Knowledge of FDA, EMA, and other global Life Sciences regulatory frameworks, including GxP requirements such as GMP, GCP, and GLP, as well as GAMP 5 principles.
  • Experience with Life Sciences digital transformation initiatives and technologies, including MES, Electronic Batch Records (EBR), PLM, laboratory informatics, quality management systems, industrial data management, AI, digital thread, and digital twin technologies.
  • Bachelor’s degree from an accredited university.
  • Ability to travel approximately 30–40%.
  • Must be eligible to work in the U.S. without visa sponsorship.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Understanding Siemens’ portfolio, with the ability to identify and apply relevant solutions across Digital Industries, Smart Infrastructure, Mobility, Software, Financial Services, and consulting offerings to address Life Sciences customer needs.
  • Proven ability to drive strategic business development in highly regulated environments, including identifying growth opportunities, developing account strategies, and navigating complex sales cycles and customer pursuits.
  • Ability to translate Siemens technologies and digitalization capabilities into meaningful customer outcomes, such as accelerating drug development and technology transfer, improving manufacturing efficiency and quality, increasing asset availability, strengthening regulatory compliance, and reducing operational risk.
  • Ability to engage credibly with customers on Life Sciences reference architectures, digital manufacturing strategies, and technology roadmaps.
  • Strong customer-facing and executive credibility with senior leaders across pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device, and CDMO organizations.
  • Demonstrated understanding of the broader Life Sciences ecosystem, including technology partners, OEMs and machine builders, engineering and system integration partners, and industry organizations such as ISPE.
  • Strong cross-functional leadership and influence, with the ability to align diverse internal businesses and teams while engaging effectively with customers, regulators, technology partners, and industry leaders.
  • Strategic and commercial acumen, with the ability to anticipate industry and regulatory shifts, translate market needs into growth priorities and business plans, and connect Siemens’ broader portfolio to customer challenges across the Life Sciences value chain.
  • Innovation and digital transformation mindset, with an understanding of emerging technologies and their potential to accelerate drug discovery and development, optimize manufacturing, improve quality and productivity, and drive better outcomes across the Life Sciences value chain.

Scope, Impact & Accountability

As the Head of Vertical Market Strategy, you will be responsible for shaping and executing Siemens' U.S. growth strategy within your assigned market vertical. You will serve as the connective leader across Siemens’ businesses, bringing together teams, solutions, and expertise to help customers solve their most critical challenges.

In this highly visible role, you will translate global strategy into market-specific growth plans, identify and pursue strategic opportunities, and help drive go-to-market priorities across the U.S. market. You will serve as the voice of the U.S. customer within Siemens' global vertical organization, helping influence future portfolio development, ecosystem partnerships, and investment priorities based on evolving market needs.

Success in this position requires the ability to build alignment across a complex organization, inspire collaboration among diverse stakeholders, and orchestrate high-value opportunities that accelerate growth. Working closely with business leaders, sales teams, and subject matter experts around the world, you will play a pivotal role in strengthening Siemens' market position and expanding our impact within the industry.

About Siemens:

We are a global technology company focused on industry, infrastructure, transport, and healthcare. From more resource-efficient factories, resilient supply chains, and smarter buildings and grids to sustainable transportation as well as advanced healthcare, we create technology with purpose adding real value for customers. Learn more about Siemens here.

About this job

Design and architect large-scale AI, HPC, and cloud infrastructure for Siemens' AI Factory globally. Role involves evaluating emerging technologies, developing reference architectures, and translating IT requirements for electrical, cooling, and facility teams.

Good fit if you have 10+ years in compute, storage, or hyperscale infrastructure and 5+ years in architecture or principal engineering roles with data center experience.

Full job description

AI Factory HPC Infrastructure Deployment Architect

 

Position Overview 

 

The AI Factory HPC Infrastructure Deployment Architect will serve as a global technical authority for compute, networking, storage, memory, and IT infrastructure architecture within Siemens' AI Factory organization. The role will track how AI, hyperscale, cloud, HPC, and enterprise platforms are evolving and convert those changes into actionable AI Factory reference architectures and go-to-market guidance. The successful candidate will bring practical experience building or architecting large-scale compute, network, and storage environments and enough data-center fluency to translate upstream IT decisions into clear implications for power, cooling, controls, physical topology, resiliency, and deployment strategy. A critical responsibility is to partner with electrical, thermal/liquid cooling, controls & automation, digital thread, and regional Solutions Architects, rack density, cluster topology, network fabrics, storage architecture, and workload behavior are accurately reflected in the complete AI Factory architecture. 

 

Key Responsibilities 

  • Serve as the technical authority for AI, HPC, cloud, and enterprise infrastructure architectures. 
  • Evaluate emerging processor, accelerator, networking, memory, and storage technologies and assess their impact on AI Factory designs. 
  • Develop scalable reference architectures spanning compute, storage, networking, racks, clusters, and data hall environments. 
  • Translate IT infrastructure requirements into actionable inputs for electrical, cooling, controls, and facility design teams. 
  • Partner with customers, hyperscalers, enterprises, and technology partners on infrastructure strategy and architecture planning. 
  • Develop technical guidance, architecture frameworks, and thought leadership content supporting sales and go-to-market initiatives. 
 

Basic Qualifications 

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical discipline; Master’s preferred. 
  • 10+ years of experience in compute infrastructure, networking, storage, cloud, HPC, enterprise systems, or hyperscale environments. 
  • 5+ years in architecture, principal engineering, technical leadership, or equivalent roles. 
  • Proven experience designing or architecting large-scale infrastructure environments. 
  • Experience with AI infrastructure, accelerated computing, HPC, hyperscale, or high-density data centers. 
  • Strong customer-facing communication and stakeholder management skills. 
  • Ability to travel up to 30-50%. 
 

Technical Expertise 

  • Large-scale compute, AI, HPC, cloud, or hyperscale infrastructure environments. 
  • Server, CPU, GPU, and accelerator architectures. 
  • AI training and inference platforms. 
  • Data center networking including Ethernet, InfiniBand, RoCE, and AI fabrics. 
  • Enterprise and high-performance storage architectures. 
  • Linux, virtualization, containers, and distributed systems. 
  • Rack-level infrastructure, power, cooling, and high-density deployments. 
  • Ability to evaluate emerging technologies and translate them into scalable architecture strategies. 
 

Preferred Qualifications

  • Deep expertise in compute, HPC, networking, AI infrastructure, hyperscale systems, or a related domain. 
  • Broad knowledge across compute, networking, storage, and data center infrastructure. 
  • Strong systems thinking with the ability to translate technology trends into business and architectural value. 
  • Demonstrated ability to influence cross-functional teams and drive alignment across technical and business stakeholders. 
  • Executive presence with strong communication and presentation skills. 
  • Ability to simplify complex technologies into actionable architectural decisions. 
  • Innovation mindset with a passion for learning emerging technologies and industry trends.

Our Culture

At Siemens Grid Software, we foster an ownership culture where employees take responsibility, collaborate openly, and continuously improve. We value innovation, transparency, and data-driven decision-making. Our teams operate globally and work closely across functions to drive meaningful business outcomes.

We have major locations in Minneapolis, MN; Foster City, CA; Schenectady, NY; Houston, TX; and Wendell, NC. 


Who are we seeking?

We are looking for a Financial Analyst – Controlling with a solid foundation in finance and a genuine interest in data, analytics, and automation. You will join the Grid Software Services Americas finance team, reporting to the Head of Finance, supporting the full portfolio with a focus on Power Technologies International (PTI), our power systems consulting and engineering business.

You are a hands-on contributor who keeps the day-to-day running accurately and on time – and who looks at every manual, repetitive step and asks “how do we standardize this, and can we automate it?” You will have the support and room to make that happen, turning routine work into reliable, repeatable processes and freeing up time for analysis that helps the business make decisions.


We are looking for Financial Analyst. This position follows a remote work model, allowing employees to work primarily from a home office while supporting business needs as required.


You’ll make an impact by:

PTI Finance Operations

  • Business partnering: Support the finance partner for PTI leadership, project managers, and sales, providing analysis of revenue, margin, costs, and backlog for a consulting business that runs on people, hours, and projects.
  • Project financials: Support PTI project and order setup, review time and billing data, and maintain accurate project revenue recognition (Percentage of Completion) in SAP.
  • Utilization & capacity: Prepare utilization, capacity, and headcount reporting that feeds the monthly business review and helps leadership balance workload against demand.
  • Operational accuracy: Handle a steady volume of transactional and data-entry work with care, and document each recurring process so knowledge is shared across the team rather than held by one person.
Financial Steering & FP&A
  • Closing & Reporting: Support month-end, quarter-end, and year-end activities. Lead margin analysis and backlog reporting to ensure a clear picture of business health.
  • Variance Analysis: Prepare monthly commentary that tells the story behind the numbers, explaining variances between actual results and forecasts with clarity and insight.
  • Planning & forecasting: Contribute to budget, forecast, and recurring headquarters requests for the PTI business.
  • Business analysis: Perform targeted data analysis to identify trends, risks, and opportunities.

Commercial Operations (Order-to-Cash)

  • O2C Management: Own and improve the end-to-end Order-to-Cash process, including customer setup, order intake, invoicing, and cash receipt.
  • Issue resolution: Spot and help resolve bottlenecks in billing and collections to improve cash flow and customer satisfaction.

Standardization & Automation

  • Standardize: Turn recurring processes into consistent templates, checklists, and controls that others on the team can run.
  • Automate: Identify manual steps and reduce them over time using tools such as Power Query, Power Automate, and KNIME – progressively shifting your own time from data entry to analysis.
  • Partner on reporting: Work alongside the team’s Financial Data Architect, who owns the data models and Power BI platform; you bring the process expertise and are a key user and tester of the reporting tools.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance or Accounting.
  • 5+ years of progressive experience in finance and/or accounting roles, ideally within a multinational, software, or professional-services organization.
  • Solid understanding of IFRS 15 / US GAAP ASC 606 (Percentage of Completion, Cost-to-Cost Method), specifically within a project environment.
  • Proficiency with SAP FI and CO modules.
  • Advanced Excel skills, including Power Query and relational data modeling – well beyond VLOOKUPs.
  • A strong desire to learn and apply tools like Power BI, Power Automate, and KNIME to improve how finance works.

Position Summary 

The Industry Marketing Manager for Semiconductors turns industry strategy, customer insight, and Siemens’ portfolio strengths into focused go-to-market (GTM) priorities, differentiated messaging, executable campaign direction, and high-impact sales enablement materials. Serving as the marketing subject-matter expert for the semiconductor industry, you will connect market opportunities, customer needs, industry priorities, solution capabilities, and business objectives to create actionable strategies that accelerate awareness, engagement, pipeline creation, and revenue growth. Operating as a key integrator across industry leadership, product marketing, sales, technical experts, and implementation teams, success in this role requires both strategic industry leadership and the ability to navigate a complex, matrixed organization while maintaining a razor-sharp focus on customer relevance and business impact. 

Key Responsibilities

  • GTM Ownership & Evolution: Own and continuously evolve the semiconductor go-to-market intent, translating high-level strategy into clear target segments, buying groups, personas, Digital Thread and Solution Domain priorities, and campaign plans.

  • Audience & Persona Strategy: Lead buyer-audience definitions and validate persona-to-topic mapping to reflect how semiconductor companies organize, buy, and transform.
  • Messaging & Value Proposition: Develop and maintain industry messaging frameworks and briefs that connect customer challenges to differentiated Siemens value. Translate highly technical input into credible, outcome-led narratives for executive, technical, and operational audiences.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner effectively with industry leaders, solution managers, Digital Thread Factory leads, solution/core marketers, technical experts, and sales to align solution definition, audience strategy, and messaging.
  • Campaign & Content Direction: Lead integrated campaign definitions from strategy through handoff, providing complete inputs for campaign overviews, prioritized topics, audiences, imperatives, messaging, and content requirements while supporting content creators with clear strategic direction.
  • Sales Enablement: Own the creation and delivery of enablement and go-to-market materials that sellers use because they map directly to real customer priorities. Customer Insight & Market Intelligence: Build a continuous feedback loop through customer conversations, sales interactions, customer advocacy, events, market research, and performance data to validate assumptions and guide investment.

Join our dynamic Global Storage Team, a strategic pillar supporting Siemens Digital Industries Software's engineers and corporate staff across numerous R&D centers and offices worldwide. 


The Role

As a Senior Storage Administrator, you will be instrumental in driving efficiency and innovation by assisting with the automation of our enterprise storage infrastructure. You'll leverage your deep expertise in NetApp and EverPure/Pure Storage to deliver highly available, performant, and cost-effective solutions, playing a critical role in our digital transformation journey.


Key Responsibilities

The Senior Storage Administrator will also be responsible for critical storage operations support in a primarily NAS environment and will participate in a global on-call rotation. Must be able to perform problem resolution in an effective and timely manner in accordance with SLA's and customer expectations. Time management and prioritization skills will be required to accommodate business requirements and manage scheduled activities. Must work well in a team environment and possess strong written and verbal communication skills.

  • Infrastructure Management: Storage platforms administration, monitoring, upgrading, installation and setup, configuration, testing, and deployments optimized for software development and build environments.

  • Performance Engineering & Tuning: Drive performance tuning, capacity planning, and troubleshooting in large-scale enterprise environments with high IOPs and throughput demands (supporting CI/CD pipelines, EDA workloads, and developer scratch spaces).

  • Automation & Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Spearhead process automation, expert scripting, and IaC to enable self-service storage provisioning for engineering teams.

  • Vendor & Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with architecture, DevOps, and service delivery teams on new and existing infrastructure initiatives; manage vendor escalations for critical support issues.

  • Operations & Support: Handle tier-3 support tickets for complex customer/developer issues and participate in a global on-call rotation. Ensure reliable operations in a primarily NAS/SAN environment in accordance with strict SLAs.

Job Qualifications

  • Education: BS degree (or equivalent) in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field. MS degree is preferred.

  • Experience: 5+ years of directly applicable enterprise storage administration experience in large-scale corporate or software engineering environments.

  • Core Storage Expertise:

    • 5+ years working with Network Appliance NAS/SAN technologies, including in-depth experience with NetApp Cluster Mode (cDot) and management tools (e.g., Active IQ Unified Manager).

    • Hands-on administration and troubleshooting experience with Everpure Storage or modern all-flash scale-out platforms.

    • Robust understanding of Data Protection technologies, including SnapMirror/Snapvault replications and disaster recovery paradigms.

  • Software Development & Engineering Support Alignment:

    • Demonstrated experience supporting software development organizations, understanding the unique IO profile of software builds, test execution, compilation workloads, and artifact repositories.

    • Familiarity with High-Performance Computing (HPC) and EDA (Electronic Design Automation) storage requirements (handling high small-file IOPS, concurrency, and massive throughput).

  • Automation & Scripting: Strong scripting and automation skills using Python, PowerShell, Ansible, REST APIs, and Terraform/IaC to eliminate manual administrative toil.

  • OS & Networking Fundamentals: Solid understanding of networking protocols (NFS, SMB/CIFS, TCP/IP) and deep operating system administration skills (Linux and Windows) for diagnosing client-side storage bottlenecks, permissions, and mount issues.

Technical Marketing Manager 

 

Team: Siemens, Data Centers & AI Factories, Marketing & Communications 
Location: U.S. Remote (access to a major U.S. airport) 

 

Transform the everyday with us! At Siemens, we combine the real and digital worlds to enable sustainable progress. Our global, diverse team puts people first, supporting and challenging you to grow in new ways. 

 

Role Overview 

The Technical Marketing Manager bridges technical development and commercial go-to-market strategy for our Data Centers & AI Factories vertical. By combining deep technical fluency with strategic storytelling, you will translate complex technologies such as power systems, cooling, automation, and digital twins into credible, value-driven narratives and assets that empower sales teams, partners, and customers. 

 

Key Responsibilities 

  • Content Creation & Storytelling: Architect and produce high-impact technical assets including white papers, solution briefs, reference architectures, technical presentations, and demos that articulate Siemens’ business and technical value. 
  • Sales & Partner Enablement: Build sales tools (talk tracks, FAQs, competitive guides, discovery questions) and co-deliver training programs, workshops, and launch materials to prepare sellers and ecosystem partners. 
  • Technical Validation: Collaborate with SMEs, engineers, and solution architects to validate technical claims, benchmarks, simulations, and proofs of value for accuracy and credibility. 
  • Cross-Functional Bridge: Serve as the bridge between technical teams, product management, sales, marketing, and partners to ensure consistent, appropriate audience messaging. 
  • Optimization & Innovation: Leverage feedback, performance data analytics, and emerging approaches (including generative AI and interactive media) to continuously improve content quality and relevance. 

You’ll win us over by having the following qualifications:  

Basic Qualifications 

 
  • Experience: 8+ years in technical marketing, solutions marketing, product marketing, technical communications, solutions architecture, or engineering within B2B technology. 
  • Education: Bachelor’s or higher degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Data Center Infrastructure, Technical Communications, Marketing, or a related field. 
  • Content & Communication: Proven ability to translate complex technical concepts into accurate, compelling narratives across multiple formats (white papers, visual-story telling, presentations, reference architectures). 
  • Collaboration & Cross-Functional Leadership: Experience partnering with engineering, product, sales, and executive stakeholders to drive alignment and validate technical claims. 
  • Enablement & Readiness: Demonstrated track record of creating and delivering training, sales tools, or readiness programs that equip teams to position complex solutions. 
  • Autonomy: A self-starter with strong project management skills, capable of managing multiple priorities independently in a fast-paced, matrixed global organization. 
 

Preferred Qualifications 

 
  • Domain Depth: Familiarity with the full data center lifecycle (design, construction, operation, optimization) and target segments (hyperscalers, neo-cloud, colocation, enterprise, EPCs). 
  • AI & Modern Tools: Experience leveraging generative AI/LLMs responsibly for content scaling, alongside familiarity with modern content management and sales enablement platforms. 
  • Portfolio: A portfolio of technical writing, solution content, demonstrations, or enablement materials showcasing your ability to communicate complex technologies effectively.

Our Fire Alarm Systems Technicians are responsible for the installation, programming, start-up, and commissioning of state-of-the-art fire alarm equipment, including fire safety, mass notification, detectors, and field peripherals. As a Fire Alarm Technician, you will:

  • Participate in Operational Testing, Verification, and Acceptance: run routine reports to review system operation, conduct final inspections and testing, and support customer acceptance and the Authority Having Jurisdiction (AHJ). 
  • Assist in customer training on system operations and provide necessary plans and fire safety system documents for as-built drawings; identify code and non-conformance issues and make recommendations for system installation
  • Conduct project site communication and coordination by supporting scheduling trade contractors to coordinate start-up services and adhere to local, corporate, and OSHA safety policies and procedures


You will make an impact with these qualifications:

Basic Qualifications: 

  • 2+ years experience programming commercial fire alarm systems
  • NICET II Fire Alarm Systems Certification
  • Must be willing and able to differentiate types/colors of wire; use hand tools, laptop, email, smartphone, and tablet; carry and move equipment and tools weighing up to 75 pounds unassisted
  • Must be 18 years of age and possess a valid driver's license with limited violations; must meet eligibility requirements to participate in Siemens' fleet vehicle program
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States on a continual and permanent basis without company sponsorship

Preferred Qualifications: 

  • High school diploma or state-recognized GED; Associate degree in electronics or related field 
  • 3+ years’ experience programming commercial fire alarm systems 
  • Ability to read/understand design and construction documents

Head of Flexible Production - Zone Americas

Here at Siemens, we take pride in enabling sustainable progress through technology. We do this through empowering customers by combining the real and digital worlds. We do this through empowering customers by combining the real and digital worlds, thereby improving how we live, work, and move today and for the next generation! We know that the only way a business thrives is if our people are thriving. That’s why we always put our people first. Our global, diverse team would be happy to support you and challenge you to grow in new ways. Who knows where our shared journey will take you?

Transform the everyday with us! 

The Head of Horizontal Flexible Production plays a pivotal role in driving order intake, business growth, and market development within Zone Americas. By leveraging deep expertise in Flexible Production solutions, planning software, technical architecture knowledge, and sales expertise, the role accelerates opportunity creation, supports regional sales organizations, and aligns customer requirements with the global Horizontal Flexible Production strategy.

We are seeking a business development professional to drive growth of Siemens Automation solutions within the Advanced Manufacturing ecosystem across the Americas. This role will focus on machine builders, AMR/AGV & robotics providers, integrators, and manufacturing technology partners, helping expand adoption of Siemens automation technologies and strengthen Siemens' position in the next generation of manufacturing equipment. This aligns with the ecosystem, machine builder, and automation focus identified in the Americas Advanced Manufacturing strategy.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute business development strategy focused on Flexible Production working with machine builders, AMR/AGV & robotics providers, integrators, manufacturing technology partners and end customers.
  • Drive adoption of Siemens Automation solutions including Automation, Motion Control, Drives, Visualization, Industrial Edge, AI, and Robotics technologies.
  • Build and maintain relationships with OEMs, integrators, research organizations, and industry partners.
  • Support development of advanced manufacturing solutions including flexible manufacturing, hybrid manufacturing, robotics, and factory automation applications.
  • Identify and develop new automation-focused opportunities across strategic OEM accounts.
  • Work closely with Siemens account teams, business units, and technical resources to develop customer opportunities.
  • Represent Siemens at industry events including IMTS, Automate and other manufacturing conferences.
  • Monitor market trends, competitive technologies, and emerging manufacturing equipment providers.
  • Support ecosystem development initiatives that strengthen Siemens' position within the Additive Manufacturing industry.

You’ll win us over by having the following qualifications:

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, Automation, or related field.
  • 8+ years of experience in industrial automation, machine tools, robotics, manufacturing systems, or related industries.
  • Experience working with OEMs, machine builders, system integrators, or manufacturing technology providers.
  • Strong understanding of industrial automation and machine control technologies.
  • Strong understanding of digital twin including planning and simulation software.
  • Proven track record of business development and customer engagement.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and relationship-building skills.
  • Willingness to travel extensively throughout Zone Americas (primarily US but includes Canada, Mexico and Brazil).

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with AMR/AGV and robotic fleets used for manufacturing technologies and applications.
  • Knowledge of CNC systems, robotics, motion control, PLCs, and digital manufacturing solutions.
  • Existing network within the Additive Manufacturing, Machine Tool, Robotics, or Industrial Automation industries.
  • Familiarity with Aerospace, Defense, Energy, and Industrial Machinery markets.
  • Understanding of advanced manufacturing and factory automation trends

Here at Siemens, we take pride in enabling sustainable progress through technology. Siemens Digital Industries is hiring an Engagement Manager (EM) to lead architect a small portfolio of strategic end-user accounts in the process industries: Chemicals, Glass, Energy, Life Sciences, and Consumer Packaged Goods.

The scope of this role is automation in manufacturing environments — process control systems, batch and continuous production, plant-floor operations technology, predictive maintenance, IT/OT with an emphasis of industrial AI in operations, and the modernization of legacy control system installed base.

The EM spearheads the technical and commercial engagement across the process industries accounts. You will define the multi-year automation "first of's" and modernization roadmaps for each customer, architect the lifecycle program that delivers it, and lead the cross-functional team that sells and executes it. This is an individual contributor role with no direct reports; you will lead through influence across sales, product, services, marketing, and customer executive stakeholders.

This position is remote with the flexibility to reside anywhere within the Continental United States.

This position is remote with the flexibility to reside anywhere within the Continental United States.


You'll make an impact by:

  • You architect the automation in manufacturing vision and map the customer from where they are to where they want to be, with the lifecycle program to get them there.
  • Own the multi-year outcome roadmap for a small set of strategic accounts — from C-suite ambition (operational performance, modernization ROI, time-to-value, sustainability targets) to the technical execution that makes it real.
  • Protect scope integrity end-to-end. No surprise scope creep. No "we'll figure it out in execution." You are the integrity check between what was sold and what gets delivered.
  • Compress order closure speed on your accounts — you are the roadblock breaker, the escalation path, the deal architect.
  • Build next-wave pipeline from inside the install base, and the champion for new large labels — every closed deal is a launchpad for the next three. Cross-portfolio thinking is the default, not the upsell.
  • Orchestrate cross-functional account teams — sellers, application engineers, product specialists, service leads, and partners — toward one coherent engagement.
  • Coach by example. No org chart authority required — your influence comes from being the most prepared, most strategic, and most outcome-focused person in the room.

You'll win us over by having the following qualifications:

Required Qualifications:

  • 10+ years in the process industries — Chemicals, Energy, Life Sciences, or Consumer Packaged Goods. 
  • Worked as the end-user in any of the process industries

Low Voltage Drives Field Service Engineer

Here at Siemens, we take pride in enabling sustainable progress through technology. We do this through empowering customers by combining the real and digital worlds. We do this through empowering customers by combining the real and digital worlds, thereby improving how we live, work, and move today and for the next generation! You’ll make an impact by:

Siemens is seeking a Low Voltage Drives Field Service Engineer to provide expert onsite and remote support for industrial drive systems across customer facilities. This role supports installation, startup, commissioning, preventive maintenance, troubleshooting, repair, upgrades, retrofits, and customer training for Siemens low voltage drive products and related automation systems.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on technical professional who enjoys solving complex problems in industrial environments, working directly with customers, and helping keep critical manufacturing and process operations running safely and reliably.

Seventy percent travel or more is expected and proximity to a major airport is required.

What You’ll Do

  • Perform field service activities for Siemens low voltage drives, including SINAMICS G120, G130, G150, S120, Masterdrives, DC drives, and related drive platforms.
  • Support installation, startup, commissioning, testing, tuning, troubleshooting, repair, preventive maintenance, and modernization work at customer sites.
  • Diagnose hardware, software, communication, motor, and power-related issues using electrical schematics, drive parameters, diagnostic tools, meters, and test equipment.
  • Provide technical and operational support for low voltage drives, motion control, PLC/HMI interfaces, motor control centers, and related industrial automation equipment.
  • Perform emergency break-fix service and scheduled service work in manufacturing, process, utility, marine, and heavy industrial environments.
  • Create clear service reports, timesheets, test records, recommendations, and follow-up actions after each assignment.
  • Communicate professionally with customers, project managers, technical support, sales, and internal service teams.
  • Train customer maintenance and operations personnel on proper equipment operation, inspection, maintenance, and basic troubleshooting.
  • Identify opportunities for spare parts, service agreements, upgrades, retrofits, training, and reliability improvements.
  • Follow Siemens safety procedures, customer site requirements, lockout/tagout practices, and applicable electrical safety standards.

You’ll win us over by having the following qualifications:

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, electrical engineering technology, automation, mechatronics, or a related technical field; equivalent technical experience may be considered.
  • 8+ years of experience installing, commissioning, troubleshooting, or maintaining low voltage AC drive systems in industrial environments.
  • Strong working knowledge of variable frequency drives, motors, power electronics, control wiring, industrial networks, and electrical troubleshooting.
  • Ability to read and interpret electrical drawings, control schematics, wiring diagrams, mechanical layouts, and technical manuals.
  • Comfort working independently at customer sites while managing priorities, documentation, and customer communication.
  • Strong problem-solving, communication, organization, and customer service skills.
  • Valid driver’s license and ability to meet customer site access requirements.
  • Proficient in English both written and verbal
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States on a continual and permanent basis without company sponsorship
  • Travel: Ability to travel frequently, including short-notice assignments, overnight travel, overtime, weekends, and emergency service support when required up to 70% or more of the time.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with Siemens SINAMICS drives, STARTER, Startdrive, TIA Portal, PLCs, HMIs, and industrial communication networks is strongly preferred.
  • Hands-on experience with SINAMICS G120, G130, G150, S120, DCM, SIMOVERT Master drives, and similar industrial drive systems.
  • Experience supporting drive applications such as pumps, fans, compressors, conveyors, cranes, mills, extruders, and process equipment.
  • Knowledge of preventive maintenance practices, insulation testing, parameter backup/restoration, firmware updates, drive replacement, and system recommissioning.
  • Experience with PLC integration, PROFIBUS, PROFINET, Ethernet/IP, Modbus, or other industrial networks.
  • Familiarity with OSHA, NFPA 70E, lockout/tagout, and customer site safety practices.

Full job description

Smart Buildings Automation Service Sales Internship 

Location:  Hiring TWO Interns 

(1) Miami area office, located in Miramar, FL

(1) Orlando area office, located in Winter Park, FL

Undergraduate: Rising Sophomore or Junior


Duration: 10 weeks
Start Dates: May 17, May 24, June 7, or June 14, 2027
Hours: Full-time, 40 hours/week

 

Here at Siemens, we take pride in enabling sustainable progress through technology. We do this through empowering customers by combining the real and digital worlds. Improving how we live, work, and move today and for the next generation! We know that the only way a business thrives is if our people are thriving. That’s why we always put our people first. Our global, diverse team would be happy to support you and challenge you to grow in new ways. Who knows where our shared journey will take you?  

Who designs your future?  You do. 

Are you looking for an internship where you can showcase your technical aptitude and passion for problem solving to ensure customers can work in a comfortable, safe, and energy-efficient environment? Does gaining hands-on experience, real-world skills and valuable knowledge while developing yourself professionally sound exciting to you? 

Join our Siemens Smart Buildings Internship Program as a Building Automation Service Sales Intern in Summer 2027!


How long is the Building Automation Service Sales Internship and when can I start?

This internship is a 10-week program where you will rotate through various departments at your local branch office, focusing all on smart buildings and sustainable infrastructure.  Internship Program Start Dates: May 17, May 24, June 7 or June 14, 2027.

What is Building Automation?

Siemens Building Automation Systems is a building management system (BMS) that automatically manages and controls all systems within a building. These systems include lighting, heating, cooling, ventilation, fire detection and notification, CCTV, door and window controls, water and waste management. It consists of sensors, controllers, software and communication devices. Siemens offers building automation systems for all building types and sizes, and for every use. The system is designed to manage a wide range of building systems, such as HVAC, lighting, security, fire safety, and other critical building functions.

Click HERE to learn more about Siemens’ Building Automation and Control Systems.

What is Building Automation Service Sales?

The Building Automation Service Sales Team is committed to supporting our Service Agreements business within our commercial Smart Buildings Automation Controls Service team.   This Sales Team supports our Building Automation Operations Team whose focus is to perform automation service and maintenance in large commercial buildings such as hospitals, universities, and industrial facilities. Our Sales Executives are ambassadors of quality Siemens technology, products and services. 


What will I do as a Building Automation Service Sales Intern?

  • Work alongside Sales Managers and Sales Executives within the local branch office.
  • Assist the sales team with lead generation, prospecting, and account outreach.
  • Support the preparation of sales presentations, proposals, and reports.
  • Help manage CRM data by tracking leads and maintaining data accuracy.
  • Shadow sales calls and meetings to learn effective sales techniques.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (operations, other business units, departments, etc.) to support customer engagement
  • Analyze sales performance data and provide insights into driving growth.
  • Participate in team meetings and contribute creative ideas for improving sales processes.
  • Participate in sales related activities (learning how to prospect, go-to-market, build B2B relationships, on-the-job training and shadowing, etc.)

·       Rotate through our core business segments, which include Building Automation, Fire/Life Safety, Security and Energy/Sustainability Systems. 

 

What will my responsibilities be as a Building Automation Service Sales Intern?

  • Position Siemens as an industry leader among service providers, leveraging Siemens world-class digital service delivery as a key differentiator. 
  • Collaborate with operations and internal teams to deliver excellent customer outcomes. 
  • Help prospect for new customers and engage with existing customers on new offerings. 
  • Visit customer sites with both Solutions and Services Sales Teams. 
  • Develop value-based proposals, estimates, specifications, and presentations.
  • Work with operations, finance, legal and other inside and outside resources to obtain the sale. 
  • Attend job take-offs and turnover meetings. 
  • Actively participate in sales department meetings, workshops, and seminars to stay knowledgeable on current market, business, and product trends. 

The goal of this internship program is to develop future talent for the Siemens organization and help you identify where you may be interested in pursuing a career at Siemens post-graduation. 

To apply for the Building Automation Service Sales Internship, candidates must meet the following requirements:

  • Education: Must be current enrollment as an undergraduate at an accredited 4-year U.S. college or university.
  • Majors: Pursing a degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Energy/Sustainability, Built Environment, Construction Management or Business Administration, Sales/Marketing with a strong technical engineering aptitude. 
  • Preferred: Participation in a school sponsored sales engineering club/organization, pursuing a professional sales certificate or similar.
  • Availability:  Ability to work 40-hours per week for the 10-week program (May - July or June - August).
  • Relocation: No relocation assistance or housing stipend is provided.  Must be willing and able to work at the branch office location and surrounding local area. 
  • Work Authorization:  Must be legally authorized to work in the United States on a continual and permanent basis without company or school sponsorship.  This program does not support students on a Visa such as F1, J1, M1 and H1B as well as OPT/CPT.

Benefits:

The hourly pay range for this position is $24 - $28 per hour, based off of your projected graduation year.  The actual wage offered may be lower or higher depending on budget and candidate experience, knowledge, skills, qualifications, and premium geographic location.  Additionally, interns for Siemens are eligible to contribute into our 401K program.

Quick facts

  • Location: Remote

About this job

Siemens EDA seeks a Technical Marketing Engineer to drive marketing and solution development for Advanced IC Packaging, focusing on 2.5D and 3DIC design flows. The role involves building tool workflows using Tcl and Python, creating technical content, and engaging customers to translate their design challenges into solution concepts.

Good fit if you have 5+ years in 2.5D/3DIC design or EDA support, strong scripting skills in Tcl and Python, and experience in technical or customer-facing engineering roles.

Full job description

Siemens EDA is a global technology leader in Electronic Design Automation software. Our software tools enable companies around the world to develop highly innovative electronic products faster and more cost-effectively. Our customers use our tools to push the boundaries of technology and physics to deliver better products in the increasingly complex world of chip, board, and system design.

Position Summary

The Technical Marketing Engineer is responsible for driving technical marketing and solution development for EBS-centered offerings in the area of Advanced IC Packaging, with particular focus on 2.5D and 3DIC design flows.

This role requires the ability to understand customer challenges and use cases, and to translate them into solution-oriented workflows by connecting planning, layout, and verification tools using scripting technologies such as Tcl and Python. The ideal candidate will be able to engage customers in technical discussions, articulate solution value, and help shape future workflow directions, including emerging approaches that may involve agent-based technologies.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and deliver technical marketing materials such as videos, presentations, and lab/demo content for Advanced IC Packaging solutions.
  • Build and demonstrate solution workflows for 2.5D and 3DIC design by connecting multiple tools, including planning, layout, and verification tools, using Tcl and Python.
  • Engage customers in technical discussions to understand design challenges, workflow gaps, and use-case requirements.
  • Translate customer technical requirements and related business needs into actionable input for development teams.
  • Understand newly developed products and enhancement features, and communicate their technical value and applicability to customers.
  • Support the definition and evolution of solution concepts that address current and future customer workflows.

As an Applications engineer with Siemens EDA Technology Solutions Sales, you will support consultative sales efforts at the world’s leading semiconductor and electronic equipment manufacturers.


As an Applications Engineer at Siemens EDA, your primary responsibility is to secure technical design wins for Siemens EDA's product and service offerings. Specifically, you will be responsible for technical wins with the industry leading solutions Innovator 3D IC Layout,  Innovator3D IC Integrator, Xpedition, Calibre, HyperLynx, and other product families. Responsible activities will include delivery of technical presentations, conducting product demonstrations and benchmarks, and participation in development of solutions and account strategies leading to market share gains for Siemens.  This position is also expected to help architect and prototype Siemens EDA’s emerging 3DIC solution through the development of flows and integration scripts to link tools into a solution.


Your territory coverage consists of Key Accounts located throughout the US.  You will be responsible for integrating with peers located all over the world, communicating essential status to a variety of stakeholders and influential customers.  International travel may be required.

Job Qualifications

MSEE/BSEE with 4+ years design experience. Significant experience in advanced IC Package layout design and/or interposer layout design. Experience with IC design is a plus.  Necessary technical skills include satisfying many of these areas:

  • Knowledge of IC Package Design (Cadence APD/SiP, Siemens Xpedition/i3DL) is required.
  • Practical experience with Package design tools from design setup (stackup/constraints/etc), to implementation (routing/outgassing/re-use/etc), through generation of manufacturing documents is required.
  • Familiarity with Package / Interposer planning solutions (Siemens XSI/i3DI, Cadence OrbitIO/ISP, Synopsys 3DIC Compiler, Excel) is preferred.
  • Familiarity with 2.5D and 3D chiplet-based design solutions (TSMC InFO, CoWoS, Intel EMIB, Foveros, ASE FoCUS, Amkor SWIFT, Samsung I/H/X-Cube, etc.) is preferred.
  • Knowledge of IC data formats (Verilog, LEF/DEF, GDS, OASIS, etc.) is desired.
  • Familiarity with signal/power integrity tools (HyperLynx, Sigrity, SIWave, ADS, etc) and analysis flows is preferred
  • Experience with Siemens Calibre DRC, LVS, and/or 3DSTACK solutions is highly desirable.
  • Above average competency with Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
  • Scripting/Programming: VBS, Python, Tcl, Perl, or similar languages.
  • Working OS knowledge of Windows and Linux.
  • Prior experience as an Applications Engineer is preferred.

The ideal candidate will:

  • Possess a passion to learn and perform at the cutting edge of technology.
  • Have a desire to broaden exposure to the business aspects of the technical design world.
  • Enjoy contributing to the success of a great team.
  • Be able to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Effectively influence people at any level.
  • Enjoy helping and motivating others to be successful.
  • Demonstrated ability to build strong rapport and credibility with customer organizations while maintaining a company internal network of contacts.

As a Senior Building Automation Programmer – PLC & Industrial Controls create advanced programming solutions for complex building automation, HVAC controls, and PLC-based control systems in new and existing facilities. This role supports data centers, pharmaceutical facilities, laboratories, central utility plants, and other mission-critical environments by developing reliable control logic, PLC programs, system integration programming, point mapping, functional testing documentation, and technical solutions that meet customer requirements, improve operational performance, and support successful project execution.

 

As a Building Automation Programmer, you will:

  • Program large, complex, and custom projects using PLC-based programming platforms and control logic.
  • Develop and implement PLC programs using Siemens TIA Portal, including structured control logic for mission-critical building automation and industrial control applications. 
  • Design, conﬁgure, and support visualization solutions, including HMI and SCADA interfaces, to provide operators with clear system status, alarms, trends, and control information.
  • Provide post-sale assistance for programming labor estimating.
  • Test PLC programs prior to initial release for quality assurance and functional performance.
  • Create functional testing and commissioning documents utilized to validate PLC logic, system integration, and ﬁeld performance.
  • Support commissioning, start-up, optimization, error analysis, and troubleshooting of PLC-based automation systems in coordination with project teams and ﬁeld resources.
  • Document PLC software solutions, system conﬁguration, testing results, revisions, and integration requirements to support quality control and long-term maintainability.
  • Assist the Graphics Design team by coordinating dynamic point information, alarms, trends, and PLC-integrated system data into graphics.
  • Collaborate with the Design Team to identify speciﬁcation discrepancies, coordinate PLC integration requirements, and request clariﬁcation as needed.
  • Work both independently and in team dynamics in a remote environment.
  • Mentor, train, and provide technical assistance to other team members.
  • Travel as needed up to 25%

 

You will make an impact with these qualifications:

Basic Qualifications: 

  • High School Diploma, or state-recognized GED. 
  • Demonstrated experience programming commercial building automation, HVAC, or industrial control systems using PLC-based control strategies.
  • Solid knowledge of Siemens PLC programming, especially Siemens S7-1200/1500 platforms and Siemens TIA Portal.
  • 5+ years of experience with structured programming methods aligned with IEC 61131-3 programming standards; ladder logic is the preferred programming language for this role.
  •  5+ years of demonstrated experience with Siemens or third-party PLC platforms, control logic development, and system integration.
  • Demonstrated electro-mechanical aptitude to read and understand design drawings, control schematics, sequence of operations, points lists, and construction documents.
  • Ability to travel up to 25%. 
  • Proﬁcient in Microsoft Office.
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States on a continual and permanent basis without company sponsorship.
Preferred Qualiﬁcations:
  • Associate or Bachelor's degree
  • 7+ years of experience with Siemens or third-party PLC platforms, control logic development, and integrated system programming
  • Demonstrated knowledge of PLC-based control systems, industrial communication protocols, and building automation system integration, including PROFINET, OPC UA, Ethernet/IP, or similar protocols based on applicable work experience
  • Experience with HMI/SCADA visualization platforms, drives technology, high-level programming languages such as Python or C#/.NET, robotics, or IT security in industrial systems

As a Senior Building Automation Programmer – PLC & Industrial Controls create advanced programming solutions for complex building automation, HVAC controls, and PLC-based control systems in new and existing facilities. This role supports data centers, pharmaceutical facilities, laboratories, central utility plants, and other mission-critical environments by developing reliable control logic, PLC programs, system integration programming, point mapping, functional testing documentation, and technical solutions that meet customer requirements, improve operational performance, and support successful project execution.

 

As a Building Automation Programmer, you will:

  • Program large, complex, and custom projects using PLC-based programming platforms and control logic.
  • Develop and implement PLC programs using Siemens TIA Portal, including structured control logic for mission-critical building automation and industrial control applications. 
  • Design, conﬁgure, and support visualization solutions, including HMI and SCADA interfaces, to provide operators with clear system status, alarms, trends, and control information.
  • Provide post-sale assistance for programming labor estimating.
  • Test PLC programs prior to initial release for quality assurance and functional performance.
  • Create functional testing and commissioning documents utilized to validate PLC logic, system integration, and ﬁeld performance.
  • Support commissioning, start-up, optimization, error analysis, and troubleshooting of PLC-based automation systems in coordination with project teams and ﬁeld resources.
  • Document PLC software solutions, system conﬁguration, testing results, revisions, and integration requirements to support quality control and long-term maintainability.
  • Assist the Graphics Design team by coordinating dynamic point information, alarms, trends, and PLC-integrated system data into graphics.
  • Collaborate with the Design Team to identify speciﬁcation discrepancies, coordinate PLC integration requirements, and request clariﬁcation as needed.
  • Work both independently and in team dynamics in a remote environment.
  • Mentor, train, and provide technical assistance to other team members.
  • Travel as needed up to 25%

 

You will make an impact with these qualifications:

Basic Qualifications: 

  • High School Diploma, or state-recognized GED. 
  • Demonstrated experience programming commercial building automation, HVAC, or industrial control systems using PLC-based control strategies.
  • Solid knowledge of Siemens PLC programming, especially Siemens S7-1200/1500 platforms and Siemens TIA Portal.
  • 5+ years of experience with structured programming methods aligned with IEC 61131-3 programming standards; ladder logic is the preferred programming language for this role.
  •  5+ years of demonstrated experience with Siemens or third-party PLC platforms, control logic development, and system integration.
  • Demonstrated electro-mechanical aptitude to read and understand design drawings, control schematics, sequence of operations, points lists, and construction documents.
  • Ability to travel up to 25%. 
  • Proﬁcient in Microsoft Office.
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States on a continual and permanent basis without company sponsorship.
Preferred Qualiﬁcations:
  • Associate or Bachelor's degree
  • 7+ years of experience with Siemens or third-party PLC platforms, control logic development, and integrated system programming
  • Demonstrated knowledge of PLC-based control systems, industrial communication protocols, and building automation system integration, including PROFINET, OPC UA, Ethernet/IP, or similar protocols based on applicable work experience
  • Experience with HMI/SCADA visualization platforms, drives technology, high-level programming languages such as Python or C#/.NET, robotics, or IT security in industrial systems

Sales and Use Tax Accountant

Here at Siemens, we take pride in enabling sustainable progress through technology. We do this through empowering customers by combining the real and digital worlds.
