About this job

Siemens seeks a Grid Operations Architect to design and lead the strategic transformation of a global high-performance computing infrastructure serving 3,000 engineers. The role owns the architectural vision for scaling from 263,000 cores to nearly one million cores across 18+ distributed grids while migrating to a modern scheduler platform.

Good fit if you have deep experience architecting large-scale distributed computing systems, scheduler platforms, and capacity planning at enterprise scale.

Full job description

We are a leading global software company dedicated to the world of computer aided design, 3D modeling and simulation— helping innovative global manufacturers design better products, faster! With the resources of a large company, and the energy of a software start-up, we have fun together while creating a world class software portfolio. Our culture encourages creativity, welcomes fresh thinking, and focuses on growth, so our people, our business, and our customers can achieve their full potential.


Position Overview:

Siemens DISW’s Engineering Grid Computing Services team strategically supports over 3000 engineers located in R&D centers worldwide. The Engineering Grid Computing Service (EGCS) within GTI operates 18+ globally distributed high-performance computing grids across 7+ sites, currently provisioning 263,000+ CPU cores across four scheduler platforms (Altair Grid Engine, Altair Accelerator, IBM LSF, and SLURM). This infrastructure processes up to 12 million jobs per day at peak and serves approximately 3,000 engineers — it is the compute backbone that chip design, verification, and validation depend on. We are seeking a Grid Operations Architect to own the architectural vision and technical strategy for the next generation of this computing fabric. The immediate mandate: scale consolidated grid capacity from a quarter million cores to almost one million cores over the next five-six years while simultaneously transforming and modernizing the entire environment— the migration from Altair Grid Engine to Accelerator Plus, a hierarchical scheduler purpose-built for the throughput demands of EDA workloads This is a senior technical leadership role that bridges grid operations, infrastructure engineering, and strategic planning. Today, a lean team of 3 core grid administrators and 4 regional service delivery partners operate this global service — the Architect role is the structural investment that accelerates transformation and reduces key-person risk. You will define how Siemens DISW’s compute infrastructure is designed, deployed, and operated on a world-class scale. The key purposes of this role are based on the following: 

  • As EDA workloads grow and push the limits of what performance can be achieved with existing designs, a next generation architecture is the answer to meet the growing computing demands.
  • The Accelerator migration is the architectural response — and it needs a dedicated owner.
  • Key Technical/Strategic leadership need has been identified, providing depth and resilience to team
  • The path to 24x5 follow-the-sun coverage, >50% toil reduction through automation, and full-service excellence depends on an architectural foundation that today's operational team does not have the bandwidth to design.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own the multiyear architectural roadmap for scaling grid compute capacity from 263K+ cores to 1M+ cores across 18+ globally distributed grids, consolidating across sites while maintaining availability and performance.
  • Design the phased migration plan from AGE to Accelerator's hierarchical scheduling platform
  • Design next generation grid topologies, scheduling frameworks, and resource management strategies that optimize utilization, throughput, and cost efficiency at a million core scale. One of the largest grids alone handles 60K+ cores and 2M+ jobs/dayarchitectures must perform at this density.
  • Develop consolidation strategies to reduce operational complexity rationalizing 4 scheduler platforms toward a unified Accelerator based model, standardizing tooling, and harmonizing operational policies across regions.
  • Lead capacity planning and forecasting models that project compute demand growth using linear, exponential, and flat percentage projections. Translate business requirements into infrastructure investment plans aligned with the 80% utilization ceiling and 72% procurement trigger governance model.
  • Architect hybrid and cloud burst strategies (e.g., NavOps ) to augment on premises capacity for peak demand and elastic workloads working with A&S and Networking teams while respecting the latency and data locality requirements of EDA workloads
  • Design fault - tolerant, self healing grid architectures that minimize downtime and reduce manual intervention critical for enabling 24x5 follow the sun coverage without proportional headcount growth.
  • Establish architectural standards, reference designs, and best practices for grid deployment, configuration, and lifecycle management across all 18+ grids and 9+ clusters.
  • Design and drive the evolution of the grid automation and tooling ecosystem — modernizing legacy Perl/Shell-based operational tools toward scalable, maintainable platforms (Python, APIs, infrastructure-as-code, GitLab CI/CD). Target: >50% reduction in manual operational toil across 8 identified operational areas.
  • Architect the observability and analytics stack (Elastic Stack with geo-redundant instances across Americas and Asia, Grafana, Power BI) to provide real-time visibility into grid performance, availability, utilization, and capacity across all grids.
  • Design AI-assisted alerting and auto-classification capabilities leveraging Elastic AI Agent and ServiceNow API integration to move from reactive monitoring to predictive operations.
  • Evolve SLA frameworks and operational KPIs from current state to improve reporting, performance: 99.97% availability per quarter, >97% SLO compliance, 30-minute MTTR, job wait time tracking at P50 and P95.
  • Lead proof-of-concept and pilot initiatives for emerging technologies (containerised workloads, GPU/accelerator scheduling, next-gen schedulers) and evaluate their applicability to Siemens EDA workloads.
  • Partner with engineering leadership, R&D teams, and business stakeholders to understand compute demand trends, workload characteristics, and evolving requirements.
  • Collaborate with A&S team, Infrastructure Technology Verticals — networking, storage, virtualization, and data center operations — to ensure end-to-end infrastructure coherence and performance.
  • Serve as the primary technical liaison with grid software vendors (Altair/Siemens, IBM, SchedMD) for roadmap alignment, escalation management, and strategic feature requests. Leverage Siemens' internal ownership of Altair for strategic advantage.
  • Present architectural proposals, trade-off analyses, and investment recommendations to senior IT leadership and executive stakeholders. Connect every infrastructure investment to a business outcome.
  • Mentor and provide technical guidance to grid administrators and operations engineers, elevating the team's architectural thinking and engineering practices. Drive cross-training from 2 to 3+ schedulers per person.
  • Establish and maintain grid operations governance — change management (moving toward Git-based infrastructure-as-code), configuration standards, security policies, and compliance frameworks for large-scale compute environments.
  • Drive continuous improvement through data-driven analysis of incidents, performance trends, and utilization patterns using Elastic dashboards and capacity modelling tools (Griddash).
  • Design self-service onboarding and provisioning workflows (ServiceNow catalogue items) to reduce manual provisioning overhead and improve time-to-compute for engineering teams.
  • Ensure software license compliance across all grid engines and associated tooling — particularly critical during the scheduler consolidation from 3 license agreements to 1.
  • Contribute to disaster recovery and business continuity planning for grid services.
  • Participate in daily operations standups, weekly staff meetings, and bi-weekly cadences with key customer teams. Provide architectural input on operational issues and escalations.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree (or equivalent) in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field. Master's degree preferred.
  • 15+ years of progressive experience in systems engineering, infrastructure architecture, or HPC/grid computing environments, with at least 5 years in an architecture or technical leadership role.
  • Deep expertise with distributed computing platforms — hands-on experience architecting and operating at least two of: Altair Grid Engine, Altair Accelerator, IBM LSF, SLURM, or equivalent workload schedulers.
  • Demonstrated experience scaling compute infrastructure in large, multi-site, enterprise-wide environments (100K+ cores). Experience with scheduler migrations or platform consolidation at production scale.
  • Strong systems-level knowledge of Linux (RHEL/CentOS), including kernel tuning, performance optimization, and large-scale fleet management.
  • Proficiency in infrastructure automation and tooling — Python, Perl, Shell scripting — with experience in modern approaches (Ansible, Terraform, infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD pipelines).
  • Solid understanding of networking (TCP/IP, DNS, NFS/GPFS, InfiniBand), storage architectures, and virtualisation as they relate to HPC and grid computing.
  • Experience in cloud computing platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP, OCI) and hybrid cloud/cloud-burst architectures for HPC workloads (e.g., NavOps, Cycle Cloud).
  • Proven ability to develop and communicate multi-year technical roadmaps and translate business requirements into architectural decisions with clear investment justification.
  • Strong project management, prioritization, and stakeholder management skills with experience presenting to senior leadership and executive audiences.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to present complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Certification in one or more of cloud computing platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP, OCI)
  • Knowledge of containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes, Singularity) and their application in HPC environments.
  • Experience with observability and analytics platforms (Elastic Stack, Grafana, Prometheus,
  • Power BI) at scale — particularly geo-distributed deployments.
  • Familiarity with AI/ML operations and GPU/accelerator scheduling for heterogeneous computing architectures.
  • Experience with database systems (MySQL, MSSQL, PostgreSQL) for operational data management and reporting.
  • Understanding ITIL 4 processes — incident management, problem management, change control— in large-scale infrastructure operations.
  • Experience supporting EDA (Electronic Design Automation) workloads — simulation, regression,
  • DRC/LVS, benchmarking, and tape-out compute patterns.
  • Background in capacity planning, financial modelling for infrastructure investments, and TCO analysis.

This is not a traditional grid administration role. The Grid Operations Architect will shape the strategic direction of one of the largest compute fabrics in the industry — an infrastructure that processes up to 12 million jobs per day and directly enables the design and verification of next-generation

semiconductors. You will lead the most significant technology transformation in the service's history (the Accelerator migration), architect a 4x capacity scale-up across a globally distributed footprint and design the automation and observability foundations that make million-core operations sustainable.

If you thrive on solving complex scaling challenges, influencing technology strategy at the intersection of HPC and enterprise IT, and building infrastructure that operates at world-class scale — this role offers an exceptional opportunity to leave a lasting mark on Siemens’ engineering capability.


This position will be subject to U.S. export control requirements under the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) and/or Export Administration Regulations (EAR).  Employment is contingent on either verifying the U.S. Person status or obtaining any necessary export license.

Job.JobDescription:
About Siemens Digital Industries Software

We are a leading global software company dedicated to computer aided design, 3D modeling and simulation—helping innovative global manufacturers design better products, faster! With the resources of a large company and the energy of a software start-up, we create a world-class software portfolio. Our culture encourages creativity, welcomes fresh thinking, and focuses on growth.

Position Overview

Lead our Federal Aerospace & Defense sales team covering the U.S. Air Force, U.S. Army, and Department of Energy. You'll nurture executive customer relationships and develop multi-year sales strategies to drive adoption of our Xcelerator portfolio and core products—Teamcenter, NX, and related solutions. Managing five Client Sales Executives, you'll build a high-performing team focused on delivering innovative PLM solutions to federal customers and supporting the war-fighter mission. The Federal group generates significant revenue, and you'll play a critical role in expanding this presence across the Department of War and its supply base. You'll work collaboratively with Sales Managers covering Aerospace & Defense original equipment manufacturers to ensure coordinated strategy and seamless customer engagement.

Key Responsibilities

Customer Relationship & Strategic Leadership

  • Build and maintain high-quality relationships with senior and executive leadership across federal agencies, including U.S. Air Force, U.S. Army, and Department of Energy
  • Lead the development and execution of long-term comprehensive strategies for customer retention and growth, ensuring continuous focus across cross-functional sales teams on identifying and executing new business opportunities
  • Nurture executive customer relationships and collaborate with sales and technical leadership to develop and implement high-impact multi-year sales strategies
  • Lead quarterly business reviews and strategic account planning with key federal customers
  • Navigate complex, sophisticated federal sales cycles and coordinate across federal contracting vehicles and procurement processes
  • Understand customer strategy, PLM solution strategy, and their alignment to drive value-based selling

Team Development & Sales Execution

  • Develop, motivate, and coach a high-performing team of five Client Sales Executives to progress and close business using standard sales methodologies
  • Supervise the development and implementation of in-depth account strategy plans aligned with federal customer requirements and strategic objectives
  • Provide mentorship and coaching to team members on complex deal negotiations and customer relationship management
  • Drive identification and execution of new business opportunities within the federal sector, ensuring quota achievement across the team
  • Foster a team culture that emphasizes high ownership, customer-first focus, fast-paced execution, high integrity, and an optimistic environment

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Growth

  • Work effectively in a matrixed environment with internal teams and external partners across the Aerospace & Defense organization
  • Collaborate with sales managers covering Aerospace & Defense original equipment manufacturers to ensure coordinated strategy and avoid conflicts
  • Build strong relationships and partnerships both internally and externally; quickly establish trust with senior leaders and empower cross-functional teams to develop solutions
  • Ensure alignment between company objectives and customer needs, balancing growth with customer success and optimizing results at the company level
  • Address competing priorities and solve complex problems in a timely manner
  • Support partner sales representatives in understanding federal customer needs and provide training on new initiatives, including perpetual-to-SaaS migration transactions

Required Qualifications

  • Minimum 10 years' experience selling large strategic enterprise software solutions to the Department of War, with ability to navigate complex federal sales cycles. This software sales experience is a non-negotiable.
  • At least 2+ years of managing a sales team, directly or indirectly
  • At least 3-5+ years experience selling into the US Military sector.
  • Consistent track record of planning, negotiating, and closing deals with highly complex accounts
  • Proven quota achievement throughout career with demonstrated success delivering results
  • At least 3+ years' experience in large enterprise software, selling at the C-suite (CXO) level
  • Success leading a matrixed environment and building relationships and partnerships both internally and externally
  • Outstanding interpersonal, oral, and written communication skills with ability to engage customers at all levels, including executive and C-level leadership
  • Excellent business judgment and demonstrated success delivering results optimized at the company level (balanced between company and customer needs)
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office (PowerPoint, Excel, Project), Salesforce.com, SAP, and other job-related software
  • Ability to understand federal customer strategy, PLM solution strategy, and their alignment
  • Ability to understand sophisticated and typically long sales cycles at the strategic level
  • Must currently reside in the continental USA (firm requirement)
  • 4-year college degree required

Preferred Qualifications

  • Military background or experience in the defense sector
  • Knowledge of government contracting and federal procurement vehicles (GSA, IDIQ, etc.)
  • Experience with federal compliance and export control requirements
  • Understanding of Department of War acquisition processes and requirements
  • Familiarity with Siemens Digital Industries Software portfolio and related products
  • Experience with perpetual-to-SaaS migration strategies and cloud-based software models

Employment Requirements

Accordingly, U.S. citizenship is required for this role. This requirement is a bona fide occupational qualification.  This position requires access to facilities or systems operated by the U.S. Department of War which restricts access to U.S. citizens

Qualified applicants must be legally authorized for employment in the United States. Qualified applicants will not require employer-sponsored work authorization now or in the future for employment in the United States


Why Us

At Siemens Software, flexibility is how we work—hybrid by default, built on trust and autonomy. Together, 30,000 people across more than 200 countries build technology that shapes the real world. You'll grow through real projects, strong technical peers, and global mobility, backed by the scale and benefits of an industrial software leader. We're committed to equality and inclusion, and we hire based on merit, skills, and impact. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!

Our Commitment to Equity and Inclusion

We value your unique identity and perspective. We are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society. We welcome you to bring your authentic self and transform the everyday with us.

Work Environment

Remote role based anywhere in the continental USA with some travel to federal customer sites and internal meetings. Travel required to support customer engagement, account planning, and team leadership activities.

About this job

Lead or Senior Power Systems Consultant role at Siemens Grid Software performing large-scale electrical transmission system simulations and consulting engagements. Remote position in the contiguous U.S. supporting grid integration of renewables, storage, and other assets while mentoring junior consultants.

Good fit if you have 5+ years of transmission power systems analysis experience, proficiency with PSS®E, and work history with major ISOs or utilities like PJM, MISO, or ERCOT.

Full job description

Who are we?

Here at Siemens Grid Software, our mission is to accelerate and secure the energy transition in a sustainable and profitable way. And for that we need you! We are paving the way for autonomous grid management empowering grid operators to accelerate their digital transformation easier, faster, and at scale.

By leaving behind traditional ways of tackling the net zero challenge and embracing the powerful capabilities of software and digital technology, we turn the complexity of grids into competitive advantage. No matter where power comes from or where it goes, we make sure it makes its way at every step.

 Find out how Siemens Grid Software is decoding the future of energy.

Join our team, get inspired, and help us re-imagine the world! Transform the everyday with us!

We are looking for a Lead or Senior Power Systems Consultant to join Grid Software’s Power Technologies International (PTI) team. PTI is our trusted advisor that takes a holistic approach, providing business advisory, technical consulting, and simulation software solutions. This role is critical to planning and integrating renewables, storage, large loads, and FACTS devices into the electrical grid. The Lead or Senior Power Systems Consultant will perform large-scale simulations of electrical transmission systems for Utilities, Regional Transmission Organizations, and energy asset owners to develop solutions for safe and reliable power system operations, while mentoring others on the team.

This is a remote position based in the contiguous U.S.

What you will be working on:

  • Performing and leading consulting engagements related to power grid analysis and design, system dynamics and transients, system interconnection, and grid code compliance.
  • Supporting and managing project execution, tracking project progress, and making necessary adjustments to maintain scope, schedule, budget, and quality.
  • Producing reports and presentations in collaboration with team members to communicate study results.
  • Maintaining relationships with clients to ensure satisfaction, analyzing clients’ business requirements and identifying opportunities for further business.
  • Supporting and leading proposal preparation by developing project plans, budgets, and timelines.
  • Supporting technical reviews of ongoing studies and contributing to the mentoring and development of junior consultants.
  • Developing automation scripts to streamline repetitive tasks, reduce errors, and boost overall efficiency.
  • Delivering on-site consulting and training services.

Minimum requirements:

  • Bachelor’s or postgraduate degree in Electrical Engineering.
  • Minimum of 5 years of professional experience performing transmission power systems analysis, with demonstrated ability to independently execute and interpret power flow and dynamic stability studies.
  • Professional experience with at least one of the following: electric utilities, ISOs/RTOs, developers, electrical utilities consulting company, or national labs, including work involving at least one of PJM, MISO, ISO-NE, NYISO, ERCOT, or SPP.
  • Experience analyzing power flow and dynamic stability using PSS®E, and experience with or working knowledge of at least one of TSAT™, TARA, PSLF™, or PowerWorld.
  • Working knowledge of NERC Reliability Standards and an understanding of RTO and other regional planning criteria, procedures, and practices.
  • Strong communication, presentation, and listening skills with demonstrated ability to write effective technical reports.
  • Ability to travel up to 10% domestically and internationally.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Prior relevant consulting and/or business development experience.
  • Experience in distribution planning, DER integration, or microgrids, and familiarity with or experience using CYME, Synergi, or OpenDSS.
  • Industry experience performing power system transient analysis using PSCAD™.
  • Experience leading studies, managing budgets and schedules, and mentoring or developing others professionally.

About this job

Design and implement building automation systems for AI Factory facilities, integrating Building Management Systems with PLCs, power monitoring, and digital twin platforms. Focus on scalable telemetry architectures and data flow optimization using protocols like MQTT, OPC UA, and BACnet/IP.

Good fit if you have 5+ years in building automation or control systems, expertise with BMS, and proficiency in multiple industrial communication protocols.

Full job description

Position Summary  

The AI Factory Building Automation Engineer is a critical technical leader responsible for integrating and optimizing building technology within our mission-critical AI Factory facilities. Leveraging deep expertise in Building Management Systems (BMS) and advanced communication protocols, you will design and implement scalable telemetry architectures, ensuring seamless data flow from operational systems to digital twin platforms. Your work will be instrumental in defining robust alarm, KPI, and visualization strategies, balancing comprehensive observability with stringent system performance requirements.  

You’ll make an impact by  

  • Applying deep expertise in Building Management Systems (BMS), specifically Siemens Desigo CC, to manage and optimize mission-critical facilities.  
  • Designing and implementing scalable telemetry architectures for high-volume, high-frequency operational data within complex building systems.  
  • Integrating BMS with various critical platforms, including PLCs, EPMS (Electrical Power Monitoring Systems), DCIM (Data Center Infrastructure Management), and digital twin environments.  
  • Ensuring all integrations and data flows adhere to strict latency, bandwidth, and reliability constraints essential for AI Factory operations.  
  • Defining scalable alarm, Key Performance Indicator (KPI), and visualization strategies that effectively balance comprehensive observability with optimal system performance.  
  • Utilizing proficiency in communication protocols such as MQTT, REST APIs, OPC UA, BACnet/IP, and Modbus TCP to facilitate robust system interoperability.  
  • Contributing to the overall efficiency, reliability, and advanced monitoring capabilities of Siemens' AI Factory infrastructure. 
Responsibilities:
  • Support feasibility studies of data center cooling/ compute system control and optimization technologies
  • Lead concept development for joint automation/ controls offering
  • Implement test/ demo projects with partners
  • Setting up MQTT/ REST API/ Modbus/ Redfish integration
  • Test/ Implement Sequence of Control in Amesim/ TIA for simulation and validation

Core Competencies  

  • Building Management Systems (BMS): Deep expertise in BMS, particularly Siemens Desigo CC, for mission-critical facilities.  
  • Communication Protocols: Proficiency in MQTT, REST APIs, OPC UA, BACnet/IP, and Modbus TCP.  
  • Telemetry Architecture Design: Proven ability to design scalable telemetry architectures for high-volume, high-frequency operational data.  
  • System Integration: Extensive experience integrating BMS with PLCs, EPMS, DCIM, and digital twin platforms.  
  • Performance Optimization: Ability to meet strict latency, bandwidth, and reliability constraints in integrated systems.  
  • Data Strategy: Expertise in defining scalable alarm, KPI, and visualization strategies.  
  • Mission-Critical Environments: Understanding of the unique demands and requirements of mission-critical facilities.  

Basic Qualifications  

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Computer Science, Automation/ Control System Engineering, or a related engineering field, or equivalent practical experience.  
  • 5+ years of experience in building technology, automation, or control systems within mission-critical environments.  
  • Demonstrated expertise with Building Management Systems (BMS).  
  • Proficiency in at least two of the following protocols: MQTT, REST APIs, OPC UA, BACnet/IP, Modbus TCP.  
  • Experience with designing and implementing data acquisition or telemetry systems.  
  • Proven ability to integrate diverse industrial or building systems.  
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States on a continual and permanent basis without company sponsorship.  

Preferred Qualifications  

  • Deep expertise with Siemens Desigo CC.  
  • Extensive experience with all listed communication protocols: MQTT, REST APIs, OPC UA, BACnet/IP, Modbus TCP.  
  • Demonstrated experience in designing scalable telemetry architectures for high-volume, high-frequency operational data.  
  • Direct experience integrating BMS with PLCs, EPMS, DCIM, and digital twin platforms.  
  • Experience in defining and implementing alarm, KPI, and visualization strategies for complex systems.  
  • Familiarity with digital twin concepts and their application in building management.  
  • Ability to travel domestically up to 25%, for up to a week at a time (adjust travel as needed based on actual expectations).

About this job

Product Marketing Manager for Innovator3D IC, a software suite for advanced semiconductor packaging and chiplet integration. Focus on market trends, messaging, and go-to-market strategies for signal/power integrity and simulation products used by leading semiconductor companies.

Good fit if you have 5+ years product marketing experience in IC design or packaging, understand chiplet heterogeneous integration, and can work cross-functionally with sales and product teams.

Full job description

Siemens EDA is a global technology leader in Electronic Design Automation software. Our software tools enable companies around the world to develop highly innovative electronic products faster and more cost-effectively. Our customers use our tools to push the boundaries of technology and physics to deliver better products in the increasingly complex world of chip, board, and system design.

The Electronic Board Systems Group (EBS) of Siemens EDA develops software solutions for the prototyping/pathfinding, simulation/modeling, detailed physical implementation and management of the associated data for advanced 2.5/3D IC heterogeneously integrated semiconductor packages. Advanced 2.5/3D semiconductor packaging significantly enhances system performance, integration density, and energy efficiency while enabling heterogeneous chiplet integration for AI, Hyperscalers, HPC and mobile applications. Siemens EDA has the broadest and most comprehensive technology stack in the market today. Siemens EDA has long been recognized as the innovation leader in IC and 2.5/3D packaging software solutions that cover the entire development process. The world’s leading fabless semiconductor and electronic system companies count on Siemens EDA design technologies to meet the challenge of increasing product complexity while meeting aggressive business targets.

The Opportunity: Innovator3D ICTM Product Marketing

The EBS portfolio unit is seeking a Product Marketing Manager for the Innovator3D IC product family of technologies. The Innovator3D IC™ product family enables “right first time” design and heterogeneous integration of chiplets into a high-performance integration platform. This suite of products helps companies predictably achieve their design and market window schedules by resolving the barriers of design complexity that impact design cycles, thereby accelerating designer productivity.

  The successful candidate would be able to identify market trends, opportunities, leverage key themes and customer needs in the signal/power integrity and simulation segment into marketing programs, sales materials, and field marketing campaigns.  With a strong focus on cross-functional collaboration and creating sophisticated marketing programs in a complex, ever-changing global market landscape, the successful candidate will make a material difference to revenue within the business unit.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Identify market trends, opportunities, and competitive threats to shape product and go-to-market strategies that maximize corporate revenue.
  • Define key product messages, positioning, and branding strategies to enhance market perception and adoption.
  • Leverage key industry themes and customer needs to create impactful marketing programs, customer collateral, sales materials, and field marketing campaigns.
  • Develop and execute brand and segment strategies that align with divisional initiatives and corporate goals.
  • Drive marketing programs that establish Siemens EDA and the Innovator3D IC product family as industry thought and technology leaders.
  • Support product launches, ensuring the successful adoption and continued growth of Innovator3D IC product family in the market.
  • Collaborate with Market Development and Product Strategy & Technology teams to develop and refine messaging, pricing, packaging, and promotional plans.
  • Collaborate with other Siemens EDA technology divisions to develop, message, position and promote a comprehensive 3D IC solution stack
  • Work closely with market development and sales teams to craft compelling messaging for new solutions, product releases, and marketing campaigns.
  • Monitor and analyze market trends and competitive intelligence to inform strategic decision-making.
  • Develop and execute event strategies for key trade shows, industry conferences, and customer events to enhance brand visibility and lead generation.

Job Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering or a related field (Masters degree preferred).
  • 5+ years of experience in product marketing, or a related role within the electronics industry, in the domain of IC design, IC package design or printed circuit board.
  • A firm understanding of the principles and challenges associated with the heterogeneous integration of multiple chiplets into a high-performance substrate platform including prototyping, pathfinding, detailed design, Multiphysics analysis and manufacturing signoff.
  • Strong communication and storytelling skills with the ability to translate technical features into value propositions.
  • Proven ability to develop and execute marketing campaigns.
  • Experience working cross-functionally with sales, product management, and business development teams.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret market data and customer insights.
  • Ability to travel as needed for industry events, conferences, and customer engagements.

Full job description

Here at Siemens Grid Software, our mission is to accelerate and secure the energy transition in a sustainable and profitable way. And for that we need you! We are paving the way for autonomous grid management empowering grid operators to accelerate their digital transformation easier, faster, and at scale.

By leaving behind traditional ways of tackling the net zero challenge and embracing the powerful capabilities of software and digital technology, we turn the complexity of grids into competitive advantage. No matter where power comes from or where it goes, we make sure it makes its way at every step. 

 Find out how Siemens Grid Software is decoding the future of energy.

Grid Software’s Power Technologies International (PTI) Energy Business Advisory team is helping businesses navigate complexity, drive growth, and steer strategic direction in an evolving landscape. Our wide range of services offer solutions in planning, managing risk, improving operations, conducting custom market studies, supporting M&A activities, and developing infrastructure.

We are looking for a Senior Energy Consultant to deliver valuable solutions to utilities, investors, and project developers. We seek someone with deep expertise in power market modeling to support asset valuation, curtailment and congestion analysis, strategic market outlooks, and project siting decisions. Transform the everyday with us!

  • Develop and run production cost and market models to support Integrated Resource Planning (IRP) and broader integrated system planning studies.
  • Build power price forecasts and long-term market outlooks to inform utility, developer, and investor decisions.
  • Analyze system operations, resource adequacy, and portfolio performance under different planning scenarios and policy pathways.
  • Support clients in evaluating generation, storage, and transmission investments within integrated planning frameworks.
  • Deliver insights that help clients optimize portfolios, manage risks, and align with evolving market and regulatory conditions.
  • Prepare clear, data-driven reports and presentations that communicate technical results and strategic implications.
  • Mentor junior consultants in modeling, analytics, and interpretation of results.

You’ll win us over by having the following qualifications: 

Basic qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in engineering, economics, operations research, finance, statistics, physics, or mathematics.
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience in production cost modeling and power market analytics (using  Aurora, PLEXOS, PROMOD, or other production cost modeling tools).
  • Strong understanding of U.S. power markets, renewable integration, and transmission constraints.
  • Ability and willingness to travel up to 25% of the time, primarily within the U.S.

Preferred qualifications: 

  • Prior consulting experience with utilities, developers, or investors.
  • Ability to communicate complex technical analyses in clear, client-ready deliverables.
  • Familiarity with regulatory frameworks, interconnection processes, and decarbonization policies.

The Senior Power Systems Consultant will perform large-scale simulations of electrical transmission systems for Utilities, Regional Transmission Organizations, and energy asset owners to develop solutions for safe and reliable power system operations.

What you will be working on:

  • Leading and performing advanced power system studies, including system dynamics, electromagnetic transients, interconnection analysis, and grid code compliance using industry-standard tools.

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in electrical engineering with a focus in Power Systems Engineering.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Ph.D. in electrical engineering with a focus in Power Systems Engineering
  • Additional experience with platforms like TSAT™, TARA, PSLF™, or PowerWorld preferred.
  • Good knowledge of NERC Reliability Standards with understanding of RTO and other regional planning criteria, procedures, and practices.
  • Experience leading, mentoring, or developing others professionally.

Job.JobTitle: Lead / Senior Lead Power Systems Consultant
Job.JobDescription:
Who are we?

Here at Siemens Grid Software, our mission is to accelerate and secure the energy transition in a sustainable and profitable way. And for that we need you! We are paving the way for autonomous grid management empowering grid operators to accelerate their digital transformation easier, faster, and at scale.

By leaving behind traditional ways of tackling the net zero challenge and embracing the powerful capabilities of software and digital technology, we turn the complexity of grids into competitive advantage. No matter where power comes from or where it goes, we make sure it makes its way at every step.

 Find out how Siemens Grid Software is decoding the future of energy.

Join our team, get inspired, and help us re-imagine the world! Transform the everyday with us!

We are looking for a Lead or Senior Lead Power Systems Consultant to join Grid Software’s Power Technologies International (PTI) team. This role is critical to the planning and integration of renewables, storage, and FACTS to the electrical grid and to perform large-scale simulations of electrical transmission systems for clients such as power producers, independent system operators, and transmission providers to develop solutions for safe and reliable power system operations.

This is a remote position based in the Contiguous U.S.

You’ll make an impact as you:

  • Perform transmission planning through the application of power systems planning principles to simulate and analyze the power system steady state and dynamic behavior.
  • Prepare detailed written reports describing analyses performed, conclusions, and recommendations.
  • Work in small project teams, ensuring deliverables are of high quality and projects are completed within budget and schedule.
  • Develop automation scripts to improve the speed and accuracy of simulations and analysis.
  • Support proposal preparation by developing project plans, budgets, and timelines.
  • Deliver on-site technical consulting/training services.

You’ll win us over by having the following qualifications:

Basic qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering with a minimum of 5 years of professional experience in the electric power industry (beyond academia: professional power systems work at a consulting firm, utility, national lab, ISO, RTO, etc.)
  • Candidate must have knowledge of transmission system planning or operations with experience analyzing power flow and dynamic stability using PSS®E, TARA, or TSAT in Transmission system planning and/or operations experience in MISO or SPP footprints—or PSCAD analysis experience in these or other regions (system-wide analysis preferred)
  • Ability to travel 10% domestically

Preferred qualifications:

  • Prior experience in Power System Consulting
  • Master’s degree or Ph.D. in Electrical Engineering with a specialization in Power and Energy Systems

We are looking for a Portfolio Consulting Manager to lead a Power Technologies International (PTI) team developing and providing innovative technical consulting services to Utilities, Regional Transmission Organizations, and energy asset owners. This opportunity focuses on managing people—not merely providing technical mentorship.

This is a remote position located in the contiguous U.S.

You will make an impact as you work on:

  • Expanding Siemens PTI’s consulting business in power grid analysis and design, system dynamics and transients, system interconnection, and grid code compliance.
  • Maintaining relationships with clients to ensure satisfaction while finding opportunities to provide further solutions and increase business.
  • Leading proposal development in response to requests for proposal or other client inquiries.
  • Leading and growing a team of consultants with varying levels of experience. Set clear expectations and provide regular feedback..
  • Mentoring people and helping them develop individual skills and career paths while promoting learning from successes and failures.
  • Managing project execution, tracking project progress, and making necessary adjustments to maintain scope, schedule, budget, and quality.
  • Collaborating with other Siemens Industry Business Units for a more comprehensive customer engagement.

Minimum requirements:

  • Bachelor’s or postgraduate degree in Electrical Engineering with a specialization in Power and Energy Systems.
  • Proven experience performing power systems analysis for electric utilities, RTOs, and developers.
  • Proven experience leading and developing teams.
  • Power systems analysis experience with PSS/E required; experience with other grid analysis software such as TSAT™, TARA, PSLF™, PowerWorld, PSCAD™, etc. highly desired.
  • Good knowledge of NERC Reliability Standards with understanding of RTO and other regional planning criteria, procedures, and practices.
  • Strong communication, presentation, and listening skills with demonstrated ability to write effective technical reports.
  • Ability to travel 10% domestically and internationally.

Preferred qualifications:

  • At least 10 years of experience related to power systems analysis as described above.
  • At least 2 years of proven experience managing or developing teams.
  • Prior consulting experience desired.
  • Experience working in the PJM, NYISO, and/or SPP regions.

Full job description

Who are we?

Here at Siemens Grid Software, our mission is to accelerate and secure the energy transition in a sustainable and profitable way. And for that we need you! We are paving the way for autonomous grid management empowering grid operators to accelerate their digital transformation easier, faster, and at scale.

By leaving behind traditional ways of tackling the net zero challenge and embracing the powerful capabilities of software and digital technology, we turn the complexity of grids into competitive advantage. No matter where power comes from or where it goes, we make sure it makes its way at every step.

Find out how Siemens Grid Software is decoding the future of energy.

Join our team, get inspired, and help us re-imagine the world! Transform the everyday with us!

We are looking for a Lead Power Systems Consultant to join Grid Software’s Power Technologies International (PTI) team. PTI is our trusted advisor that takes a holistic approach, providing business advisory, technical consulting, and simulation software solutions. This role is critical to the planning and integration of renewables, storage, and FACTS to the electrical grid. The Senior Power Systems Lead will perform large-scale simulations of electrical transmission systems for Utilities, Regional Transmission Organizations, and energy asset owners to develop solutions for safe and reliable power system operations, while mentoring others on the team.

This is a remote position based in the contiguous U.S.

What you will be working on:

  • Performing/leading consulting engagements related to power grid analysis and design, system dynamics and transients, system interconnection, and grid code compliance.
  • Managing/supporting project execution, tracking project progress, and making necessary adjustments to maintain scope, schedule, budget, and quality.
  • Producing reports and presentations with study results in collaboration with team members.
  • Maintaining relationships with clients to ensure satisfaction, analyzing clients’ business requirements and identifying opportunities for further business.
  • Supporting proposal preparation by developing project plans, budgets, and timelines.
  • Providing mentoring and technical development to junior consultants.
  • Developing automation scripts to streamline repetitive tasks, reduce errors, and boost overall efficiency.
  • Delivering on-site consulting and training services.

Minimum requirements:

  • Bachelor’s or postgraduate degree in Electrical Engineering.
  • Minimum of 3 years of professional experience performing power systems analysis for electric utilities, ISOs, RTOs, developers, or national labs; 5+ years preferred.
  • Experience leading, mentoring, or developing others professionally.
  • Experience analyzing power flow and dynamic stability using PSS®E required; additional experience with TSAT™, TARA, PSLF™, or PowerWorld. preferred.
  • Good knowledge of NERC Reliability Standards with understanding of RTO and other regional planning criteria, procedures, and practices.
  • Strong communication, presentation, and listening skills with demonstrated ability to write effective technical reports.
  • Ability to travel 10% domestically and internationally.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Prior relevant consulting experience.
  • Experience working in the ISO-NE, PJM, and/or SPP regions
  • Experience in distribution planning.
  • Industry experience performing power system transient analysis using PSCAD™ or EMTP-RV

Integrated Medical Services LPN

Pay: $27.00 - $30.00 per hour

Summary

As an Integrated Medical Services LPN at Aspire Health Partners, your job purpose will be to provide direct patient care, medication administration, clinical monitoring, and documentation within the scope of Florida nursing practice and under appropriate supervision.

This role supports clients receiving behavioral health, crisis stabilization, detoxification, and substance-use treatment services while promoting safety, recovery, and continuity of care.

Key Responsibilities

  • Deliver safe, compassionate nursing care, including assessments, vital signs, clinical monitoring, treatments, and activities of daily living.
  • Administer medications accurately, monitor therapeutic effects and adverse reactions, maintain medication security, and report medication-related concerns.
  • Observe and report changes in physical, behavioral, psychiatric, or withdrawal-related conditions and respond appropriately to emergencies.
  • Support admissions, transfers, discharges, referrals, and interdisciplinary treatment planning.
  • Implement provider orders and perform authorized nursing procedures, including wound care, specimen collection, injections, and point-of-care testing.
  • Maintain accurate, timely, and compliant documentation in the electronic health record.
  • Promote client safety through infection control practices, risk prevention measures, crisis intervention support, and adherence to safety protocols.
  • Provide client education regarding medications, treatments, wellness, discharge planning, and recovery support.
  • Participate in quality improvement initiatives, audits, regulatory compliance activities, and ongoing professional development.
  • Collaborate effectively with nurses, providers, clients, families, and interdisciplinary teams to ensure high-quality patient care.

Work Environment

This position may involve working in behavioral health and substance-use treatment settings and requires flexibility to work evenings, nights, weekends, holidays, and overtime as needed.

The LPN is responsible for maintaining professional standards, protecting patient rights and confidentiality, and providing safe, recovery-oriented care within the legal scope of practice.

Qualifications

  • Level II Background Clearance - All Aspire Health Partners Internships and Careers require Level 2 clearance, with Aspire covering fingerprinting costs. Visit info.flclearinghouse.com to learn more.
  • Acceptable Motor Vehicle Registration driver’s license record in accordance with the underwriting guidelines set by Aspire’s insurance company.
  • Current Florida LPN License
  • Some Psychiatric Nursing experience

Integrated Medical Services Nurse Manager/Supervisor

Pay: $37.00 - $43.00 per hour

As Integrated Medical Services Nurse Manager at Aspire Health Partners, your job purpose will be to provide leadership, supervision, and clinical support to nursing staff while ensuring safe, efficient, and compliant patient care.

This role collaborates with nursing leadership, medical and psychiatric providers, and program leaders to support daily operations, staffing needs, quality improvement, and continuity of care in our mental health and substance use disorder programs including Detox and MAT.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead, supervise, coach, and evaluate nursing staff, including RNs, LPNs, and support personnel.
  • Ensure delivery of high-quality, evidence-based nursing care in compliance with organizational policies and regulatory requirements.
  • Oversee daily nursing operations, including admissions, transfers, discharges, staffing, scheduling, and patient care needs.
  • Monitor staffing levels, address coverage issues, and support recruitment, onboarding, training, and retention efforts.
  • Serve as a clinical resource for patient care issues, medical emergencies, medication concerns, and changes in patient condition.
  • Ensure accurate medication management practices, including audits, error review, controlled substance oversight, and collaboration with providers and pharmacy services.
  • Monitor clinical documentation for accuracy, completeness, timeliness, and compliance through chart reviews and audits.
  • Support quality improvement initiatives, survey readiness, accreditation standards, and compliance with state, federal, and organizational regulations.
  • Investigate incidents, participate in root cause analyses, implement corrective actions, and promote strategies that enhance patient and staff safety.
  • Collaborate across disciplines to support continuity of care, operational effectiveness, and positive patient outcomes.

This position combines clinical oversight, staff leadership, operational management, regulatory compliance, and quality improvement to ensure safe and effective nursing services.

Qualifications

  • Current RN Florida License
  • BSN preferred
  • Five Years or equivalent previous background in areas of Nursing Supervision
  • Level II Background clearance- All Aspire Health Partners Internships and Careers require Level 2 clearance, with Aspire covering fingerprinting costs. Visit info.flclearinghouse.c.om to learn more.
  • Acceptable Motor Vehicle Registration driver’s license record in accordance with the underwriting guidelines set by Aspire Insurance Company, as described in the AHP Corporate Transportation Policy 3.9.1

Patient Care Tech (PCT)

What will you do? As a PCT at Aspire Health Partners, your job purpose will be to provide a variety of essential functions to ensure effective operations of assigned programs.  These functions include;

  • Perform routine intake procedures relating to medical issues and initiate and maintain client medical charts.
  • Administer or observe medications and document prescription medications, blood pressure, behavior and other related issues.
  • Take client vital signs as appropriate, change wound dressings and perform other routine supervised nursing activities.
  • Order, inventory and maintain stock of prescription medications, over-the-counter drugs and first aid supplies. Assist nurse or medical provider as required during sick call.
  • May monitor clients during daily activities including work, meals and recreation to ensure compliance with program commitments and regulations.
  • Monitor client telephone conversations, assist clients in accessing program resources, complete discharge plans.
  • Transport clients to offsite activities as directed and periodically assist other staff with searches of rooms and personal belongings.
  • Communicate unusual issues or circumstances to supervisory personnel and communicate with night personnel at change of shift to provide complete information regarding current client and facility conditions.
  • May perform some administrative functions including client room assignments.
  • May facilitate group recovery meetings and house meetings, note critical issues to review with others and collect fees for services.
  • May obtain insurance benefits, authorization and continues reviews.
  • May monitor clients issuing urine samples for laboratory testing and prepare and maintain required documentation for chain of custody.
  • Document client behavior and other related data. Prepare periodic and special reports relating to work activities and project progress. 
  • Perform crisis interventions as required.
  • Ensure the proper disposal of bio-hazardous material.
  • Maintain high standards of ethical and professional conduct and adheres to agency policies and procedures.

Job.JobTitle: Integrate Medical Services Advanced Practice Registered Nurse (APRN)
Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Orlando, FL
  • Experience: 2+ years
  • Benefits: Health insurance, paid time off
  • Workplace: Drug-free workplace

About this job

APRN providing psychiatric and medical assessments, diagnoses, and treatment for patients with behavioral health, addiction, and primary care needs. Work with a multidisciplinary team in an integrated healthcare setting in Orlando.

Good fit if you have an APRN license in Florida, board certification as FNP or PMHNP, and experience in behavioral health or integrated care.

Full job description

Integrate Medical Services Advanced Practice Registered Nurse (APRN)

Aspire Health Partners is a leading Integrated behavioral health, addiction medicine, and primary care organization committed to providing comprehensive healthcare services to individuals and families. We strive to deliver high-quality, compassionate, comprehensive, and cost-effective care within an integrated, patient-centered, and supportive environment.

As a Integrated Medical Services APRN, you will play a vital role in our integrated care continuum, providing exceptional medical services to patients with a focus on behavioral health, addiction medicine, and primary care. This is an exciting opportunity to work with our multidisciplinary team to deliver exceptional care and ensure our patients receive comprehensive treatment for their mental health, addiction, and primary care needs.

Responsibilities:

  • Conduct comprehensive psychiatric and medical assessments, including health histories, physical examinations, mental status evaluations, and risk assessments.
  • Evaluate and diagnose mental health, substance use, and medical conditions, including acute and chronic illnesses, withdrawal, intoxication, and psychiatric crises.
  • Develop and implement individualized, recovery-oriented treatment plans in collaboration with clients and interdisciplinary care teams.
  • Prescribe, monitor, adjust, and discontinue medications in accordance with clinical guidelines, organizational policies, and applicable state regulations.
  • Order, interpret, and review laboratory tests, diagnostic studies, and other clinical assessments to support treatment decisions.
  • Monitor treatment effectiveness, medication adherence, side effects, safety concerns, and barriers to care.
  • Provide education regarding diagnoses, medications, treatment options, wellness strategies, and recovery goals.
  • Coordinate care with physicians, psychiatrists, therapists, nurses, pharmacists, case managers, and other healthcare professionals.
  • Identify patients requiring specialty referrals, emergency intervention, hospitalization, or higher levels of care.
  • Participate in treatment team meetings, discharge planning, case reviews, and quality improvement initiatives.
  • Maintain accurate, timely, and compliant clinical documentation in accordance with organizational, professional, and regulatory standards.

Qualifications

  • Current Advanced Practice Registered Nurse (APRN) license in the State of Florida.
  • Certification as a Family Nurse Practitioner (FNP), Psychiatric Mental Health Nurse Practitioner (PMHNP), or other applicable APRN specialty.
  • DEA registration and prescriptive authority as required.
  • Experience in behavioral health, psychiatry, primary care, substance use treatment, crisis stabilization, or integrated healthcare settings preferred.
  • Strong clinical assessment, diagnostic, treatment planning, communication, and interdisciplinary collaboration skills.

Qualifications:

  • Valid APRN license in Florida.
  • Level II Background clearance- All Aspire Health Partners Internships and Careers require Level 2 clearance, with Aspire covering fingerprinting costs. Visit https://info.flclearinghouse.c.om to learn more.
  • Master's degree in Nursing or Post MS Certificate from an accredited University/College.
  • Board Certification as a Family Nurse Practitioner (FNP), Psychiatric Mental Health Nurse Practitioner (PMHNP), or Adult Gerontological Primary Care Nurse Practitioner (AGPC).
  • 2 years of experience as a Nurse Practitioner (preferred). Willing to work with motivated new graduates.
  • Excellent clinical assessment, diagnostic, and treatment skills.
  • Ability to work collaboratively in a multidisciplinary team environment.
  • Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills, with a patient-centered approach.
  • Proficient in using electronic medical record (EMR) systems and other relevant healthcare software.

Benefits: We offer a competitive salary package and are an approved employer for Federal loan forgiveness programs. In addition, we provide a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, and vision insurance, retirement plans, paid time off, professional development opportunities, and more. We value work-life balance and prioritize the well-being of our employees.

If you are a passionate and dedicated Nurse Practitioner who thrives in an integrated care environment and is committed to making a positive impact in the lives of others, we encourage you to apply.

Aspire Health Partners is a drug-free workplace and an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants are treated without regard to their race, color, religion, national origin, sex, age, disability, or veteran status. For more information, see Aspire’s Equal Employment Opportunity Policy.

Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Pay: $22.00 an hour
  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Orlando, FL
  • Experience: 3+ years
  • Education: Bachelor's degree

About this job

Quality Data Analyst for Aspire Health Partners in Orlando supporting healthcare quality initiatives through data analysis, internal auditing, and compliance monitoring. On-site position working with clinical and administrative teams to improve organizational performance.

Good fit if you have a bachelor's degree in IT/Data Science/Health Informatics, 3+ years healthcare data analysis or quality experience, EHR system knowledge, and can work on-site in Orlando.

Full job description

Quality Data Analyst (On-Site Only – Orlando, FL)

Pay Rate: $22.00 per hour
Location: Orlando, FL 32804
Work Arrangement: 100% On-Site

Important Information for Applicants

->This position is NOT remote.
->Hybrid work is not available.
->Relocation assistance is not offered.

Applicants should be local to the Orlando area or able to reliably commute to our Orlando office. Candidates requiring relocation support or a remote work arrangement will not be considered.

Join Aspire Health Partners as a Quality Data Analyst

Are you passionate about using data to improve healthcare outcomes? Aspire Health Partners is seeking a detail-oriented and analytical Quality Data Analyst to support our mission of delivering high-quality behavioral health services. This role is ideal for a professional who enjoys uncovering insights, improving processes, ensuring compliance, and leveraging technology to drive organizational excellence.

As a Quality Data Analyst, you will work closely with clinical, administrative, and leadership teams to evaluate performance, support quality initiatives, and ensure data integrity across the organization.

What You'll Do

Data Analysis & Reporting

  • Analyze healthcare and quality performance data to identify trends, risks, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Develop, maintain, and enhance dashboards, reports, and analytics tools.
  • Provide actionable insights that support informed decision-making and operational excellence.
  • Utilize data analytics to measure outcomes and track organizational performance.

Internal Auditing & Compliance

  • Conduct internal audits across clinical and administrative departments.
  • Monitor compliance with healthcare regulations, accreditation standards, and organizational policies.
  • Identify process gaps and recommend data-driven corrective actions.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to implement and monitor audit findings and resolutions.

Quality Improvement

  • Assist in designing and executing quality improvement initiatives.
  • Conduct root cause analyses and help develop sustainable corrective action plans.
  • Monitor progress, measure results, and report findings to leadership.
  • Promote a culture of continuous improvement, accountability, and excellence.

Technology & Systems Support

  • Support the integration, optimization, and ongoing use of quality and compliance-related IT systems.
  • Ensure data accuracy, integrity, confidentiality, and security.
  • Serve as a subject matter resource for data systems, reporting tools, and quality processes.
  • Train staff on audit procedures, data reporting practices, and compliance requirements.

What We're Looking For

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Data Science, Health Informatics, or a related field.
  • Minimum 3 years of experience in data analysis, IT systems, internal auditing, or quality management within a healthcare environment.
  • Strong proficiency with data visualization and reporting tools.
  • Experience working with Electronic Health Record (EHR) systems.
  • Understanding of healthcare regulations, compliance requirements, and quality standards.
  • Excellent analytical, organizational, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • Commitment to maintaining the highest standards of professionalism, ethics, and confidentiality.
  • Power BI experience strongly preferred.
  • Certification in Healthcare Quality, Auditing, or related discipline.

Additional Requirements

Successful candidates must be able to obtain and maintain:

  • Level II Background Clearance
    All Aspire Health Partners Internships and Careers require Level 2 clearance, with Aspire covering fingerprinting costs. Click https://info.flclearinghouse.c... to learn more.
  • Acceptable Motor Vehicle Record (MVR)
    In accordance with Aspire Health Partners' transportation and insurance requirements.

Quick facts

  • Schedule: Full-time, includes weekends
  • Location: Daytona Beach, FL
  • Education: High school diploma or GED
  • License: Valid driver's license
  • Physical: Lifting up to 25 lbs

About this job

General Maintenance position at Daytona International Speedway supporting day-to-day facility upkeep including plumbing, electrical, HVAC, painting, and cleaning. Work across a 500-acre motorsports complex that hosts nine major racing weekends annually plus additional events.

Good fit if you have a high school diploma or GED with six months to one year of maintenance experience, valid Florida driver's license, and flexibility for evenings, weekends, and holidays.

Full job description

DAYTONA INTERNATIONAL SPEEDWAY

Daytona International Speedway is a state-of-the-art motorsports facility and was awarded the SportsBusiness Journal’s prestigious Sports Business Award for Sports Facility of the Year in 2016. Daytona International Speedway is the home of "The Great American Race” – the DAYTONA 500. Though the prestigious season-opening NASCAR Cup Series event garners most of the attention – as well as the largest audience in motorsports - the approximately 500-acre motorsports complex boasts the most diverse schedule of racing on the globe, thus earning it the title of "World Center of Racing."  Among the nine major weekends of racing activity are the Rolex 24 At DAYTONA, the DAYTONA Supercross, the DAYTONA 200 motorcycle classic and the Coke Zero Sugar 400. Rarely a week goes by that the Speedway grounds are not used for events that include track tours, concerts, civic and social gatherings, car shows, photo shoots, production vehicle testing and police motorcycle training.

At NASCAR, you'll work alongside passionate people creating experiences fans feel and helping shape the future of sports and entertainment.


Daytona International Speedway is seeking a General Maintenance team member to support the day-to-day maintenance and upkeep of the facility. This hands-on role will perform preventive maintenance, general repairs, and facility improvement projects to help ensure the Speedway remains safe, functional, and ready for events throughout the year.


Working across the property, this position will assist with plumbing, electrical, HVAC, painting, cleaning, and other general maintenance needs while responding to work orders and supporting facility operations.


What You’ll Do:

  • Perform preventive building maintenance and complete assigned work orders throughout the facility.
  • Complete routine plumbing repairs, including addressing clogged toilets, sinks and urinals, water leaks, and leaking faucets.
  • Perform basic electrical maintenance, including replacing light bulbs and lamps and assisting with the repair or replacement of ballasts and light fixtures.
  • Assist with HVAC maintenance and repairs as needed.
  • Safely operate aerial lifts, machinery, and other equipment required to complete maintenance projects.
  • Assemble, move, and install furniture and assist with hanging pictures, fixtures, and other facility items.
  • Support general facility upkeep through cleaning, painting, pressure washing, and repair work.
  • Assist with additional maintenance and facility projects as needed.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What You’ll Bring:

  • High school diploma or GED, six months to one year of related maintenance experience and/or training, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Basic knowledge of general building maintenance and repair practices.
  • Ability to safely use tools, equipment, machinery, and aerial lifts required for assigned work.
  • Ability to read and follow written and verbal instructions, safety procedures, work orders, and other job-related materials.
  • Basic math and problem-solving skills necessary to complete maintenance tasks and respond to routine facility issues.
  • Effective communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively with teammates and other departments.
  • Valid Florida driver’s license required.
  • Ability and willingness to travel as required.
  • Willingness to work a flexible schedule, including evenings, weekends, holidays, and extended hours as necessary to support events and facility operations.

Why This Role?

The General Maintenance team plays an important role in keeping Daytona International Speedway safe, functional, and event-ready. This position offers the opportunity to work hands-on across one of motorsports' most recognized facilities while supporting the day-to-day operations and events that bring the Speedway to life.


Physical Requirements

This position regularly requires the use of hands to handle or feel objects and reaching with hands and arms. The employee is frequently required to stand, walk, climb or balance, stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl, as well as talk and hear.

The employee must regularly be able to lift and/or move up to 25 pounds, frequently lift and/or move up to 50 pounds, and occasionally lift and/or move up to 100 pounds. Specific vision abilities required for this position include close vision, distance vision, peripheral vision, and depth perception.

About this job

Financial Analyst supporting payroll accounting, financial reporting, and salary and benefit planning at NASCAR in Daytona Beach, Florida. Role includes reconciling payroll accounts, preparing journal entries, analyzing expenses against budgets, and supporting audits using Workday and Adaptive Planning.

Good fit if you have a bachelor's degree in Finance or Accounting, 1-3 years of finance experience, payroll knowledge, and strong Excel skills.

Full job description

At NASCAR, you will work alongside passionate people creating experiences fans feel and helping shape the future of sports and entertainment.


NASCAR is seeking a Financial Analyst, Pay Services to support payroll accounting, financial reporting, and salary and benefit planning. In this role, you’ll partner with Finance, Payroll, and Benefits to ensure accurate financial records, turn data into actionable insights, and improve processes. This position will be based in Daytona Beach, Florida.


What You’ll Do

  • Reconcile payroll bank, benefit, liability, and tax accounts; investigate discrepancies and recommend solutions.
  • Prepare payroll journal entries and support month-end close in accordance with internal policies and Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP).
  • Partner with Finance to maintain accurate general ledger mappings and payroll accounting interfaces.
  • Support salary and benefit budgets and forecasts using Workday and Adaptive Planning, including data transfers, trend analysis, and projections.
  • Analyze salary and benefit expenses against budgets and forecasts, and create reports that help leaders understand variances and opportunities for improvement.
  • Perform quarterly 401(k) participation and deferral audits, coordinate corrections, and support the annual plan audit.
  • Provide data and documentation for corporate tax reporting, workers’ compensation audits, census requests, and other audits.
  • Create standard and ad hoc reports and support special projects for Payroll, Benefits, and Human Resources.
  • Help improve processes and develop training materials for reporting tools, Workday, and Adaptive Planning.
  • Provide backup support for day-to-day payroll operations as needed.

What You’ll Bring

  • A bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, or a related field and 1-3 years of finance or related experience in a midsize to large organization.
  • Payroll experience.
  • Strong Excel skills and proficiency with Microsoft Office.
  • Experience creating and maintaining reports in business reporting systems.
  • Experience with Workday and Adaptive Planning is a plus.
  • Strong analytical, financial modeling, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret complex financial and technical information.
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain financial findings to leaders and cross-functional teams.
  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to travel occasionally, with less than 5% travel expected.

Why This Role?

Put your financial skills to work behind the scenes of NASCAR. You’ll collaborate across Finance, Payroll, and Benefits, help leaders make informed decisions, and improve processes that support our employees and business.

You'll build scalable data solutions, improve data quality, and create trusted datasets that empower teams across the organization to make informed decisions. This role offers the opportunity to work with modern data technologies, collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders, and make a meaningful impact on the future of NASCAR through data-driven innovation.

  • Collaborate with engineers, analysts, and business stakeholders to understand data needs.
  • Translate defined business requirements into data solutions.
  • Develop and maintain data pipelines using SQL and Python.
  • Build integrations across data platforms, including API-based sources.
  • Apply data modeling principles to prepare datasets for reporting, analytics, and business operations.
  • Write clear, maintainable code that follows team development standards.
  • Implement data quality checks and investigate discrepancies to improve accuracy, completeness, and consistency.

  • Strong problem-solving, communication, and organizational skills.
  • Exposure to Snowflake, Apache Airflow, or comparable data platforms.

  • Experience working with APIs and structured or semi-structured data.
  • Familiarity with automated testing or GitHub Actions.
  • Interest in or experience within sports, entertainment, or media.
  • Strong attention to detail and a commitment to data quality.
  • Enthusiasm for working with data and building practical solutions.
  • Ability to manage priorities and collaborate effectively in a fast-paced environment.

Why This Role?


This is an opportunity to help shape and scale NASCAR’s data ecosystem by building the pipelines, integrations, and trusted datasets that power business operations, analytics, and strategic decision-making across the organization. You’ll work with modern cloud technologies, automation tools, and large-scale data platforms while collaborating with teams across the sport. You'll have the chance to make a visible impact, solve meaningful business challenges, and contribute to the future of NASCAR through data.

At NASCAR, you will work alongside passionate people creating experiences fans feel and helping shape the future of sports and entertainment.


NASCAR seeks a detail-oriented and collaborative professional to join our Finance team as a Staff Accountant, Accounts Receivable & Revenue.

The ideal candidate brings strong accounting knowledge, advanced Excel skills, and a commitment to accuracy while managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.


What You’ll Do

  • Support customer contract activities in Workday, including contract setup, maintenance, and appropriate revenue recognition treatment within assigned responsibilities.
  • Prepare recurring and non-recurring month-end journal entries and account reconciliations.

  • Create and maintain accurate customer records in Workday.
  • Gather supporting information and documentation for internal and external audits.
  • Identify and communicate opportunities to improve efficiency in Workday and related accounting processes.
  • Assist with special projects and other accounting or operational responsibilities as assigned.

What You’ll Bring

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting and one to three years of related experience and/or training, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Strong accounting knowledge and the ability to identify issues, research discrepancies, and develop practical solutions.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and strong working knowledge of other Microsoft Office applications.
  • Workday Financials experience preferred.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to explain accounting policies, provide clear instructions, and respond to customers, business partners, and management.
  • Ability to apply mathematical concepts, including discounts, interest, percentages, ratios, and proportions.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet tight deadlines.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively while maintaining accuracy and attention to detail.
  • A positive attitude, strong work ethic, and willingness to work occasional overtime to meet department needs.

Your attention to detail and process improvement mindset will help strengthen the financial foundation that enables NASCAR to grow, innovate, and deliver world-class experiences.
