Full job description

INTERNATIONAL MOTOR SPORTS ASSOCIATION (IMSA)

IMSA was originally founded in 1969 and owns a long and rich history in sports car racing. Today, IMSA is the sanctioning body of the IMSA WeatherTech SportsCar Championship, the premier sports car racing series in North America. IMSA also sanctions the IMSA Michelin Pilot Challenge, IMSA VP Racing SportsCar Challenge and Historic Sportscar Racing, as well as five one-make series: Ferrari Challenge North America, Lamborghini Super Trofeo North America, Whelen Mazda MX-5 Cup presented by Michelin, Mustang Challenge and Porsche Carrera Cup North America. IMSA – a company within the NASCAR family – is the exclusive strategic partner in North America with the Automobile Club de l’Ouest (ACO) which operates the 24 Hours of Le Mans as a part of the FIA World Endurance Championship. The partnership enables selected IMSA WeatherTech SportsCar Championship competitors to earn automatic entries into the prestigious 24 Hours of Le Mans. For more information, please visit www.IMSA.com, https://x.com/IMSA, www.facebook.com/IMSA or www.instagram.com/imsa_racing.

IMSA is seeking an experienced Senior Coordinator, Partnership Marketing to:

  • Help shape the success of strategic corporate partnerships that support the growth of IMSA.
  • Drive impactful partner activations and sponsorship programs that deliver measurable value.

...based in Daytona Beach, Florida.

  • Develop and maintain partnership collateral, presentations, activation materials, and event resources.
  • Serve as the at-track manager of the IMSA Business Center and support partnership initiatives at race weekends and partner events.

What You'll Bring

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, Sports Management, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • 1-3 years of experience in partnership marketing, sponsorship activation, event marketing, sports marketing, hospitality, client services, or a related field.
  • Strong project management and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

The Admissions Pricing & Promotions Coordinator supports the execution of pricing, promotional, inventory, and revenue strategies across track events. This role ensures pricing accuracy, monitors sales and inventory performance, supports promotional and secondary market initiatives, and provides reporting and analysis to inform ticketing decisions.


The ideal candidate is analytical, detail-oriented, and organized, with the ability to work effectively with data, reporting tools, ticketing systems, and cross-functional teams in a fast-paced environment.


What You’ll Do

  • Support the implementation and maintenance of event pricing, fee structures, and approved pricing changes within ticketing systems.
  • Monitor ticket inventory, sales performance, sell-through, and pricing trends to identify opportunities for optimization and revenue growth.
  • Prepare and distribute pricing, sales, inventory, revenue, and promotional performance reports and analyses.
  • Support promotional campaigns, dynamic pricing initiatives, resale activity, and inventory allocations for promotions, waitlists, relocations, and other ticketing programs.
  • Conduct market and competitive pricing research to support pricing recommendations and revenue strategies.
  • Maintain accurate pricing documentation and communicate pricing updates and decisions to internal stakeholders.

  • Strong analytical and organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail.
  • Proficient in using SQL to perform data joins, aggregations, and subqueries for business operations.
  • Capabilities in data manipulation and visualization using BI tools like Tableau are highly preferred.
  • Experience with Microsoft Excel and data reporting.
  • Familiarity with ticketing systems and CRM platforms preferred.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • A data-driven and detail-oriented approach to problem-solving.
  • Strong organizational and communication skills.
  • Curiosity about market trends and consumer behavior.
  • A collaborative, team-oriented mindset.
  • A commitment to supporting revenue growth and operational excellence.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Knowledge of dynamic pricing principles and ticket inventory management.
  • Experience preparing business reports and analyzing sales trends.
  • Familiarity with secondary ticket marketplaces and promotional campaigns.

Work Schedule

This position requires flexibility to support race weekends, special events, and business needs. Evening, weekend, and holiday work is required, along with occasional travel as needed.

About this job

Seasonal event-based position supporting maintenance operations at Daytona International Speedway. Work involves assembling track equipment, operating heavy machinery, and performing preventive maintenance during major racing events and facility activities.

Good fit if you have experience with power tools, heavy equipment operation, and general maintenance work.

Full job description

DAYTONA INTERNATIONAL SPEEDWAY

Daytona International Speedway is a state-of-the-art motorsports facility and was awarded the SportsBusiness Journal’s prestigious Sports Business Award for Sports Facility of the Year in 2016. Daytona International Speedway is the home of "The Great American Race” – the DAYTONA 500. Though the prestigious season-opening NASCAR Cup Series event garners most of the attention – as well as the largest audience in motorsports - the approximately 500-acre motorsports complex boasts the most diverse schedule of racing on the globe, thus earning it the title of "World Center of Racing."  Among the nine major weekends of racing activity are the Rolex 24 At DAYTONA, the DAYTONA Supercross, the DAYTONA 200 motorcycle classic and the Coke Zero Sugar 400. Rarely a week goes by that the Speedway grounds are not used for events that include track tours, concerts, civic and social gatherings, car shows, photo shoots, production vehicle testing and police motorcycle training.

The Daytona International Speedway seeks motivated individuals to join the Facility Operations team in the positions of Maintenance_Event based in Daytona Beach, Florida.

This position is a seasonal / event based position to assist the team in the areas of Maintenance Mechanic, Painter, Irrigation and Track Maintenance. Basic office systems knowledge including but not limited to computer system and programs, cellular phone and 2-way radios.

This position will perform routine preventative maintenance and repair procedures on race track and related infrastructures. Operate equipment and use tools as directed.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Assist in executing DIS events – major races, track rentals, other events.

  • Assemble and disassemble track equipment such as track gates, barricades, portable bleachers, etc.

  • Use all types of power tools and large equipment including forklift, front end loader, backhoe, bucket truck.

  • Perform preventive building maintenance duties.

  • Clean, repair, lubricate and maintain equipment, tools and machinery used for construction jobs.

  • Use saws, hammer, nails and bolts for framing.

  • Dig ditches or trenches, backfill excavations, compact and level earth to grade specifications using equipment, picks, or shovels

  • Perform light electrical, plumbing, drywall and carpentry repairs. Participate in general cleaning, painting, and repair work.

  • Other duties as assigned

Job.JobTitle: Guest Services Support Event Staff - Homestead-Miami Speedway
Job.CustomJobTypeName: Banquet Server / Event Staff, Hospitality / Tourism / Events
Job.JobDescription:
HOMESTEAD-MIAMI SPEEDAY

Homestead-Miami Speedway has been open since 1995 following an initiative to spur economic recovery in the aftermath of Hurricane Andrew. The Speedway, which was founded by Miami businessman, racing enthusiast and philanthropist Ralph Sanchez, is a 650-acre facility that features a 1.5-mile oval and 2.21-mile road course. The Speedway hosts on-track events nearly 300 days per year and generates more than $301 million annually for the region. NASCAR crowned champions in all three of its national series at Homestead-Miami Speedway for 18 straight years (2002-19) and will once again host NASCAR Championship weekend in 2026.

Homestead-Miami Speedway Guest Services Event Support Roles

NASCAR seeks talented professionals to join our event staff in the position of Support Team, Admissions Crew, Venue Crew, Tram Driver, Tram Ambassador, Tram Attendant, ADA Cart Support, and Information Crew based at Homestead-Miami Speedway.

SUPPORT TEAM

Setup and teardown items such as signage, tents, tables, chairs, and steel barricades, transporting staff to and from specific work locations on property, deliver items such as water coolers and event information to Fan Crew Members, assist all Guest Services departments with various tasks. Candidate must pass a Motor Vehicle Record (MVR)

ADMISSIONS CREW

Admissions Crew checks each guest's ticket or credential for valid entry into the Venue or infield.

VENUE CREW

Venue Crew are responsible for bringing our guests an unforgettable race day experience! Ushers will assist by directing guests to the location of their seats and other points of interest, enforcing Speedway policies and procedures, providing event information to guests, and making sure everything in their area is in working order. Venue Crew may also work as elevator attendants to ensure the safety of our guests.

TRAM DRIVER

Drivers are responsible for safely and efficiently transporting our guests to various areas of the Speedway and ensuring that Tram Ambassadors are performing their duties. All drivers must have a valid Class A, B, or C CDL with current physical. Candidate must also pass a Motor Vehicle Record (MVR).

TRAM AMBASSADOR

Ambassadors are paired with a Driver and ensure that all safety equipment is operational and in good repair. Ambassadors sit at the front right corner of the tram facing the passengers, ensure that passengers remain seated, make safety announcements, and provide assistance when necessary with loading/unloading.

TRAM ATTENDANT

Tram Attendants proactively assist and greet our guests as they approach the tram plaza, professionally and courteously answer questions, advise guests which queue to enter, and assist with loading/unloading the tram, including guests with disabilities.

ADA CART SUPPORT

ADA Cart Support safely transport guests with disabilities, via golf carts, to and from designated locations. Candidate must pass a Motor Vehicle Record (MVR) check.

INFORMATION CREW

Information crew is positioned at information centers that are located around property and in the Venue. The guest services representative must be able to think quickly, utilize their tools to provide our fans with accurate information in a timely manner, and ensure our fans have a positive race-day experience.

Education and/or Experience:

  • High school diploma or general education degree (GED); or one year related experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Prior customer service experience is strongly preferred.

Other Skills, Abilities, and/or qualifications

  • Minimum age 18 years old.
  • Ability to stand for long periods of time.
  • Ability to work with others and take direction.
  • Ability to maintain a professional and courteous attitude with guests at all times.
  • Ability to work nights/weekends as assigned.
  • Excellent verbal communication skills.
  • Some positions may require a valid driver’s license and pass a motor vehicle license inspection report.
  • Ability to work outdoors in changing weather conditions for extended periods.
  • Reliable transportation to and from the track location.

NASCAR is seeking a Manager, Contract Revenue, to lead accounting for assigned contract-based revenue streams. This role combines technical accounting expertise with hands-on ownership of contract review, the monthly close, audit support, and process improvement.

You will partner with teams across the business to translate complex agreements into clear accounting conclusions and help ensure revenue is recorded accurately and on time. This position is based in Daytona Beach, Florida.


What You’ll Do

  • Review and interpret contracts for assigned revenue streams, determine the appropriate accounting treatment under ASC 606 and company policies, and document conclusions in technical accounting memos when needed.
  • Oversee monthly revenue close activities, including journal entries, reconciliations, variance analysis, and financial statement preparation. Research and resolve discrepancies to support accurate, timely reporting.
  • Support the annual external audit by preparing analyses and documentation and working directly with auditors as needed.
  • Maintain revenue accounting policies and procedures, support compliance with internal controls, and recommend improvements.
  • Lead and support initiatives that streamline revenue-related processes and improve operational efficiency.
  • Help ensure accurate data flow between Workday and connected systems by overseeing mapping, translation tables, and reconciliations and partnering with system experts to resolve issues.
  • Provide financial data and analysis for special projects, strategic initiatives, and requests from teams including Tax, Legal, and Sales.


What You’ll Bring

  • Bachelor’s degree and five or more years of accounting experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Demonstrated experience with contracted revenue and a strong understanding of U.S. GAAP and ASC 606.
  • Two years of public accounting experience preferred. CPA certification or CPA eligibility is also preferred.
  • Ability to explain accounting policies and conclusions clearly to management, business partners, customers, and accounting staff.
  • Advanced Excel skills. Experience with Workday Financials preferred.
  • Strong organization and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities independently in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
  • A collaborative approach, sound judgment, and a strong commitment to accurate, timely work.
  • Experience managing staff is preferred.
  • Flexibility to work occasional overtime when needed to meet department deadlines and priorities.


Why This Role?

This is an opportunity to take ownership of complex revenue accounting while helping improve how the work gets done. You will bring clarity to contract terms, partner with teams across the business, and strengthen the processes and systems that support accurate financial reporting.

NASCAR seeks a talented professional to join in the position of Coordinator, Event Operations, based in our Homestead, Florida office.


The Coordinator of Event Operations is a key role at Homestead-Miami Speedway (HMS), supporting the successful execution of major events and year-round operations. Primary responsibilities include assisting the Guest Services team during major events—most notably NASCAR weekend—while also managing track rentals, special events, and related client needs. The position carries a strong sales component, including leasing track time, negotiating agreements, securing renewals, and identifying upsell opportunities. An interest in motorsports and car culture is essential to connect with clients and fans.

Duties include but are not limited to:

  • Manage client accounts and support the Director with daily tasks, including tracking rentals and special events.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact to ensure timely communication, contract fulfillment, renewals, upsells, and seamless execution from agreement drafting through event completion.
  • Proactively sell and lease track time by identifying new business opportunities, negotiating agreements, and maintaining a pipeline of prospects.
  • Monitor and follow up on outstanding issues related to client accounts, track rentals, or events.
  • Identify operational efficiencies and opportunities to enhance revenue and improve the guest experience.
  • Research, evaluate, and contract third-party vendors as needed to support major events and track rentals.
  • Serve as the primary liaison with Levy Catering regarding menus, event setup, and execution.
  • Prepare and distribute internal communications and post-event summaries to HMS stakeholders, capturing feedback and documenting any issues.
  • Coordinate Guest Services support for major events, including outreach, scheduling, and onboarding of volunteer groups, employee check-in, and ensuring all credentialed staff and volunteers are prepared to deliver exceptional guest experiences.
  • Contribute as a collaborative team member, assisting colleagues as needed.
  • Perform other duties as assigned by the Director of Event Operations.

Required skills / experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree from a four-year college or university with 2 years of post-graduate professional experience.  
  • Minimum two years’ experience in motorsports, sales, scheduling, logistics, or a related field.
  • Strong communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple client accounts, drive renewals, and identify upsell opportunities.
  • Experience in selling or leasing products/services, preferably in a motorsports or event environment.

INTERNATIONAL MOTOR SPORTS ASSOCIATION (IMSA)

IMSA was originally founded in 1969 and owns a long and rich history in sports car racing. Today, IMSA is the sanctioning body of the IMSA WeatherTech SportsCar Championship, the premier sports car racing series in North America. IMSA also sanctions the IMSA Michelin Pilot Challenge, IMSA VP Racing SportsCar Challenge and Historic Sportscar Racing, as well as five one-make series: Ferrari Challenge North America, Lamborghini Super Trofeo North America, Whelen Mazda MX-5 Cup presented by Michelin, Mustang Challenge and Porsche Carrera Cup North America. IMSA – a company within the NASCAR family – is the exclusive strategic partner in North America with the Automobile Club de l’Ouest (ACO) which operates the 24 Hours of Le Mans as a part of the FIA World Endurance Championship. The partnership enables selected IMSA WeatherTech SportsCar Championship competitors to earn automatic entries into the prestigious 24 Hours of Le Mans. For more information, please visit www.IMSA.com, https://x.com/IMSA, www.facebook.com/IMSA or www.instagram.com/imsa_racing.

Job Description

Job Title:                     Part-Time, Transport Driver

Department:                Logistics

FLSA Status:               Non-Exempt

Prepared Date:            November 30, 2021

Reviewed Date:            November 30, 2021

SUMMARY

This position requires a professional transport (truck) driver to drive an IMSA transporter (with trailer) to and from events and/or fly to and from events.  In addition to professional truck driving duties, this position is also responsible for set-up and teardown of equipment utilized throughout the event week/weekend as well as maintaining all equipment in a functional and professional appearing manner.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES include the following. Other duties may be assigned.

Drive transporter, often on an interstate basis, for all required events. Must be able to drive to events as prescribed while maintaining all Department of Transportation (DOT) requirements necessary to operate a transporter (i.e., Commercial Driver’s License, testing, drive time regulations, etc.).

Truck and trailer loading and unloading; setting up and breaking down of awnings, tech equipment and any equipment as needed.

Truck and trailer scheduling and minor maintenance.

Work to support all weekend officials by maintaining equipment and supplies; staff any IMSA trailers as needed.

Responsible for equipment maintenance and care including cleaning, restocking and upkeep.

Prepare truck logs, complete timecards, and fuel reports after all trips.

After performing set-up duties at the race event, will also be asked to perform other tasks to help augment other staffing needs around other departments.

Required to operate forklifts and supporting equipment.

Periodically work at the IMSA transportation hub on off-event days.

Maintain a professional appearance and demeanor.

Approximate travel required:  80% including weekends.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES

This job has no supervisory responsibilities.

QUALIFICATIONS 

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE

One (1) year certificate from college or technical school and/or five (5) years truck driving and at-race track service experience; or equivalent combination of education and experience.  Minimum of one (1) year forklift operation experience is a plus.

LANGUAGE SKILLS

Ability to read, analyze, and interpret general business periodicals, professional journals, technical procedures, or governmental regulations.  Ability to write reports, business correspondence, and procedure manuals.  Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions from small groups, customers, clients, managers, and other employees of the organization.

MATHEMATICAL SKILLS

Ability to calculate figures and amounts such as discounts, interest, commissions, proportions, percentages, area, circumference, and volume. 

COMPUTER SKILLS

Proficient on Company provided hardware and software. Must be able to work with Electronic Logging Devices (ELD) for DOT compliance in trucks.

REASONING ABILITY

Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions. Ability to interpret an extensive variety of technical instructions in mathematical or diagram form and deal with several abstract and concrete variables. Ability to make decisions and think in a fast-paced work environment.

CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, AND REGISTRATIONS

Commercial Driver’s License (CDL), Class A required and IMSA License.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS 

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to stand and walk approximately 10 hours per day; use hands to finger, handle, or feel; and reach with hands and arms.  The employee is frequently required to stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl.

The employee is occasionally required to talk or hear, sit, climb, or balance, and taste or smell.  The employee must frequently lift and/or move more than 75 pounds.  Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distant vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and ability to adjust focus.

The Driver must be able to pass the DOT physical and DOT required drug screenings.

About this job

Corner Workers monitor track conditions and driver safety at Homestead-Miami Speedway, using flags to communicate with drivers and assisting during accidents or mechanical issues. The role involves observing track surface and competitor behavior while stationed at various points around the racetrack.

Good fit if you have racing knowledge, are bilingual in English and Spanish, hold a valid driver's license, and can work flexible schedules including nights and weekends.

Full job description

HOMESTEAD-MIAMI SPEEDAY

Homestead-Miami Speedway has been open since 1995 following an initiative to spur economic recovery in the aftermath of Hurricane Andrew. The Speedway, which was founded by Miami businessman, racing enthusiast and philanthropist Ralph Sanchez, is a 650-acre facility that features a 1.5-mile oval and 2.21-mile road course. The Speedway hosts on-track events nearly 300 days per year and generates more than $301 million annually for the region. NASCAR crowned champions in all three of its national series at Homestead-Miami Speedway for 18 straight years (2002-19) and will once again host NASCAR Championship weekend in 2026.

Corner Workers are stationed at various points around the racetrack and are responsible for observing and monitoring track conditions and communicating with drivers by using flags to warn of track conditions and provide assistance in case of any collisions, accidents or track problems.

Duties include but are not limited to:

  • Provide consistent information to drivers using racing flags and signals.

  • Observe, monitor and assess track surface conditions.

  • Observe competitors for driving behavior and their cars mechanical condition.

  • May be called to assist during an accident

  • Communicate information to Race Control, stewards, Operations, and emergency medical responders.

  • High school diploma/GED

  • Valid Driver’s License

  • Racing knowledge

  • Bilingual, native in English and Spanish.

  • Ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment

  • Excellent verbal and radio communication skills

  • Must be willing to work days, nights, weekend,  occasional holidays and special events

  • Must be comfortable working in an outside environment in all non-life threatening weather conditions (i.e.: heat, cold, light rain, etc.).

  • Must be able to sit and/or stand for extended periods of time.

  • Must attend mandatory annual training and complete required online training initially and annually.

Job.JobTitle: Event Guest Services Fan Crew - Daytona International Speedway
Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Schedule: Part-time, includes weekends, shift differential pay
  • Location: Daytona Beach, FL
  • Physical: Lifting up to 30 lbs

About this job

Part-time event positions at Daytona International Speedway's major racing events, including the Daytona 500. Multiple roles available in guest services, admissions, ADA assistance, and venue support, with shifts varying from 8-14 hours depending on event needs.

Good fit if you can stand for long periods, work outdoors in changing weather, work nights and weekends, and have strong communication skills.

Full job description

DAYTONA INTERNATIONAL SPEEDWAY

Daytona International Speedway is a state-of-the-art motorsports facility and was awarded the SportsBusiness Journal’s prestigious Sports Business Award for Sports Facility of the Year in 2016. Daytona International Speedway is the home of "The Great American Race” – the DAYTONA 500. Though the prestigious season-opening NASCAR Cup Series event garners most of the attention – as well as the largest audience in motorsports - the approximately 500-acre motorsports complex boasts the most diverse schedule of racing on the globe, thus earning it the title of "World Center of Racing."  Among the nine major weekends of racing activity are the Rolex 24 At DAYTONA, the DAYTONA Supercross, the DAYTONA 200 motorcycle classic and the Coke Zero Sugar 400. Rarely a week goes by that the Speedway grounds are not used for events that include track tours, concerts, civic and social gatherings, car shows, photo shoots, production vehicle testing and police motorcycle training.

Daytona International Speedway is seeking part time event workers in the position of Guest Services Fan Crew.  As a member of the Fan Crew, you will be responsible for bringing our guests an unforgettable racing experience. Fan Crew will work select publicly ticketed events throughout the year.

Guest Services Fan Crew is a seasonal/temporary event based position. Shifts and hours will vary depending on specific event needs. 

FAN CREW JOB DESCRIPTION

  • Ability to stand for long periods of time

  • Ability to work outdoors in changing weather

  • Excellent communication skills & positive attitude Must be able to work nights, weekends & holidays

  • Shift length: 8-14 hours depending on event needs

  • Assisting fans in a safe and friendly manner

Please review the list of positions below and note on your application your 1st, 2nd and 3rd preference of role. Not all positions may be hiring at the current time.

ADA CART DRIVER FAN CREW

DRIVERS – ADA Cart Drivers Fan Crew safely transport guests with disabilities, via golf carts, to and from designated locations. Candidate must pass a Motor Vehicle Record (MVR) check.

SHUTTLE STOP – Shuttle Stop Fan Crew are crucial to the safety and efficiency of the ADA Cart program to keep an organized flow of the fan queue line and the ADA Carts.

ADMISSIONS FAN CREW

GATES – Gate Fan Crew check each guest's ticket or credential for valid entry into the Venue or infield.

CAMPGROUNDS – Campground Fan Crew check each guest's ticket and vehicle pass for access into controlled campground areas.

TUNNELS - Tunnel Fan Crew check each guest's ticket and vehicle pass for valid access into the infield & campground areas.

OVERNIGHT - Overnight Fan Crew at the Tunnels & Campgrounds keep the 24 hour operation going. Pay differential offered for those who mainly work overnight shifts.

GUEST SERVICES BOOTH FAN CREW

GUEST SERVICES BOOTH – GSB Fan Crew are positioned at Guest Services Booths that are located around property and in the Venue. GSB Fan Crew must be able to think quickly, utilize their tools to provide our fans with accurate information in a timely manner, and ensure our fans have a positive race-day experience. GSB Fan Crew are also responsible for managing the lost and found program, resolving any ticket discrepancies or issues, and taking fan feedback with a positive attitude.

VENUE FAN CREW

VENUE – Venue Fan Crew are responsible for bringing our guests an unforgettable race day experience! Ushers will assist by directing guests to the location of their seats and other points of interest, enforcing Speedway policies and procedures, providing event information to guests, and making sure everything in their area is in working order. Venue Fan Crew may also work as escalator or elevator attendants to ensure the safety of our guests.

SUPPORT TEAM

SUPPORT – Support Team assists the entire Guest Services department with critical tasks before, during, and after events. Shifts are 12+ hours. Support Team assists with setup and teardown of items such as signage, tents, tables, chairs, and steel barricades; transports staff to and from specific work locations on property; and other duties as assigned. Candidate must pass a Motor Vehicle Record (MVR) check and be able to lift in excess of 30 pounds.

WARDROBE FAN CREW

WARDROBE – Wardrobe Fan Crew oversee the organization of wardrobe for all Guest Services sub-departments by issuing and receiving uniforms. Candidate must be comfortable using a computer and may be asked to wash laundry during events.

Major event dates for 2026 & 2027:

August 28 - 29, 2026

January 29 - 31, 2027

February 16-21, 2027

March 6, 2027

Additional days may be available.

HOMESTEAD-MIAMI SPEEDAY

Homestead-Miami Speedway has been open since 1995 following an initiative to spur economic recovery in the aftermath of Hurricane Andrew. The Speedway, which was founded by Miami businessman, racing enthusiast and philanthropist Ralph Sanchez, is a 650-acre facility that features a 1.5-mile oval and 2.21-mile road course. The Speedway hosts on-track events nearly 300 days per year and generates more than $301 million annually for the region. NASCAR crowned champions in all three of its national series at Homestead-Miami Speedway for 18 straight years (2002-19) and will once again host NASCAR Championship weekend in 2026.

Join Our Street Team and Be Part of the Racing Action! 

If you have a passion for motorsports or are eager to explore the thrilling world of racing, we want to work with you! We aim to maintain year-round connections with our community, enhance awareness of Homestead-Miami Speedway, and share the thrill of NASCAR with loyal and new fans across South Florida. We are actively seeking enthusiastic and committed individuals to support us with awareness-building and community engagement efforts, with the goal of creating excitement for the upcoming NASCAR Cup Series Championship Weekend from November 6-8, 2026.. 

Since its inception in 1995, Homestead-Miami Speedway has consistently held its position as South Florida's premier motorsports destination. This is your chance to be a part of the most exhilarating racing experience in South Florida, join a dynamic and fast-paced team, and get your foot in the door in the motorsports industry! 

Responsibilities & Tasks: 

In this role, you will serve as the ambassador for Homestead-Miami Speedway at a variety of public appearances and promotional events throughout South Florida. Your mission will be to build community by connecting and engaging with both our loyal fans, newcomers, and potential customers, all with the ultimate objective of encouraging their attendance at our highly anticipated NASCAR Cup Series Championship Weekend in November. Our activations include the promo car, a NASCAR retired race car, promotional giveaways, interactive games, ability to data-collect and prospect. 

Additionally, you will: 

  • Support NASCAR marketing and event experience initiatives, including the 2026 NASCAR Cup Series Weekend, NASCAR Racing Experience Media & Influencer Day, Fourth of July Celebration at the track, and Fast Lane Friday events, to name a few.
  • Engage with customers and prospects on-site at grassroots events to generate leads and close ticket sales to the 2026 NASCAR Cup Series Weekend.
  • Collect valuable data from event attendees, actively gather prospects for future email campaigns, and encourage consumer sign-ups for our mailing list.   
  • Educate the community about Homestead-Miami Speedway, its history, and ticket opportunities.
  • Maintain expertise in the products and services offered by Homestead-Miami Speedway.
  • Always ensure we're well-stocked with promotional materials and giveaway items.
  • Actively participate in public appearances with our promo car and/or retired race car, with a primary responsibility for maintaining the impeccable condition of both vehicles.
  • Coordinate transportation of the retired race car with the towing team and supervise vehicle loading and unloading to ensure it is always handled with care as well as properly staged at events and activations.
  • Responsible for assisting in the set up and tear down of the displays. You will need to travel to the office the day prior to collect all grassroots activation. On the day of the event, you will transport these items to the event location using your own car, set up the activation, dismantle it after the event, and then return all grassroots items to Homestead-Miami Speedway post event.
  • Ideal candidates should be sales-oriented, personable, punctual, hardworking, and eager to learn about the world of NASCAR. Also, they exhibit reliability and dependability, and always adhere to safety regulations and procedures.
  • Some out-of-town travel may be required.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Requirements: 

  • Minimum 18 years of age.
  • Bilingual, native in English and Spanish.
  • Demonstrate high levels of energy and enthusiasm and professionalism when interacting with customers. Always carry a happy disposition!
  • Candidates must possess strong attention to detail and consistently strive to enhance the presentation and final display and/or activation setup.
  • Exceptional communication, interpersonal, and relationship-building skills, capable of effectively engaging with a wide range of stakeholders.
  • Creative and strategic thinker with a proactive approach to problem-solving, detail-oriented, and strong team player.
  • Self-motivated and organized, with the ability to work in a fast-paced environment and think strategically to solve problems.
  • Available to work flexible hours, including weekdays, weeknights, and evenings, adapting to event schedules.

Desired Qualifications:

  • Sales experience desired!
  • Current enrollment in a college or university program in Marketing, Communications, Public Relations, Sports Management, or a related field, with a strong interest in motorsports and event marketing.

Join our team and help us showcase Homestead-Miami Speedway as the ultimate destination for motorsports enthusiasts in South Florida!  


Behind every race weekend are talented people helping shape the future of sports and entertainment. If you are ready to make an impact alongside passionate teammates, we encourage you to apply.

Position Title: Accounting Associate

Department: Business Office

FLSA: Non-Exempt

Supervisor: Business Office Director

Supervises: N/A

About Our Mission

At Legacy Pointe at UCF, our mission is grounded in a simple and meaningful purpose: to brighten lives through lifelong enrichment, supported by our partnership with the University of Central Florida. Everything we do is built around that vision. Our community was created on the belief that older adults deserve to live with dignity, connection, opportunity, and joy- every single day.

As a Life Plan Community, we provide a full continuum of care, from independent living to assisted living and memory care, all the way to skilled nursing. Our culture is shaped by hospitality, service, and accountability, and our affiliation with UCF enhances what we offer through lifelong learning, intergenerational opportunities, and innovative programming.

Legacy Pointe is a modern, welcoming community where people feel seen, valued, and cared for. Whether someone is participating in a wellness program, engaging in a cognitive activity, receiving compassionate support, or enjoying a meaningful moment of connection, our priority is always their comfort, dignity, and quality of life.

Why People Choose Legacy Pointe

Joining Legacy Pointe means becoming part of a team that appreciates your work and supports your well-being. We want you to feel equipped, encouraged, and valued in your role. Full-time employees receive access to a comprehensive benefits package that includes:

• Medical, dental, and vision insurance

• Company-paid Basic Life Insurance

• Short-term disability options

• 401(k) retirement plan

• Paid time off that grows with tenure

• Eight paid holidays annually

• Scholarship programs for employees and dependents

• Recognition programs, including milestone awards and annual celebrations

• Employee discount program with savings on attractions, travel, and entertainment

• Annual staff appreciation events

Work That Makes a Difference

Working at Legacy Pointe is deeply meaningful. Each day brings moments where your presence, patience, and compassion can change someone’s experience for the better. You help residents feel comforted, safe, understood, and supported—especially those living with cognitive impairment, who depend on consistency and connection.

You build trust, create calm, and offer reassurance through even the simplest interactions. At the end of the day, you know your work mattered. Every role at Legacy Pointe contributes to these moments of impact, and we value the people who show up with empathy, skill, and dedication. There is purpose here. There is growth here. And there is a place for you at Legacy Pointe.

Accounting Associate – Position Summary

The Accounting Associate plays a key role in supporting the Business Office at Legacy Pointe at UCF by performing daily accounting and billing functions that ensure accurate financial operations. This position focuses on Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, and resident billing, working closely with the Business Office Director and Senior Business Office Coordinator to maintain accurate records, resolve discrepancies, support month-end close processes, and uphold internal controls and regulatory expectations. The role requires strong attention to detail, confidentiality, and the ability to provide high-quality customer service to residents, families, vendors, and internal departments.

In addition to processing invoices, payments, deposits, and resident charges, the Accounting Associate assists with reconciliations, reporting, audits, and billing accuracy across multiple departments. The position involves frequent interaction with residents and families, requiring professionalism, patience, and clear communication when addressing billing questions or concerns.

Qualifications and Requirements

  1. Associate’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field, or current enrollment in an accredited Accounting or Finance degree program
  2. Entry-level candidates welcome; 0–2 years of experience in accounting, accounts payable/receivable, bookkeeping, or billing preferred
  3. Experience in senior living, healthcare, hospitality, or multi-department organizations is a plus
  4. Strong attention to detail with the ability to maintain accurate financial records and follow established procedures
  5. Working knowledge of basic accounting principles and mathematical calculations, including percentages and reconciliations
  6. Proficiency in Microsoft Windows, Excel (including formulas), and Word; ability to learn accounting and billing systems
  7. Ability to handle confidential resident and financial information in accordance with policy and HIPAA principles
  8. Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to interact professionally with residents, families, vendors, and staff
  9. Ability to write clear and professional emails, memos, and billing-related communications
  10. Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment
  11. Ability to work independently, take initiative, use good judgment, and function effectively as part of a team
  12. Willingness to provide resident-facing customer service while maintaining professionalism

Important Notice

Applicants for this position will be required to complete a background screening through the Care Provider Background Screening Clearinghouse, per House Bill 531 (2025). Learn more:https://info.flclearinghouse.com

Quick facts

  • Schedule: Full-time, shift differential pay
  • Location: Oviedo, FL
  • Education: High school diploma or GED
  • Physical: Lifting up to 50 lbs
  • Benefits: Health insurance, 401(k), paid time off, paid holidays

Good fit if you have Florida CNA certification, current CPR/BLS certification, and can lift up to 50 pounds regularly.

Full job description

Certified Nursing Assistant (CNA) – Day Shift | Full-Time

Location: Legacy Pointe at UCF – Orlando, FL

Departments: Skilled Nursing, Assisted Living, and Memory Care

Employment Type: Full-Time

Shift: 7:00 AM – 3:00 PM

FLSA: Non-Exempt

Shift Differentials:

Weekdays (Monday 7 AM – Friday 11 PM): No day-shift differential

Weekends (Friday 11 PM – Monday 7 AM): Additional $1.00 per hour

About Legacy Pointe at UCF

At Legacy Pointe at UCF, our mission is to brighten lives through lifelong enrichment, supported by our partnership with the University of Central Florida. As a Life Plan Community, we provide a full continuum of care, including Independent Living, Assisted Living, Memory Care, and Skilled Nursing. Our community is built around hospitality, service, and accountability, with a commitment to ensuring that residents feel valued, respected, and supported.

Position Summary

Legacy Pointe at UCF is seeking compassionate and dependable Certified Nursing Assistants (CNAs) for full-time day-shift opportunities across our Skilled Nursing, Assisted Living, and Memory Care departments. The CNA provides direct, person-centered care to residents by assisting with activities of daily living, promoting independence, and supporting resident safety, dignity, and well-being. Working under the direction of the assigned department's Nurse Manager and nursing team, the CNA helps residents begin their day comfortably while maintaining a positive and supportive care environment. Department placement will be based on current staffing needs, qualifications, experience, and candidate preferences.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  1. Assist residents with morning routines, bathing, dressing, grooming, toileting, and personal hygiene.
  2. Support residents with activities of daily living (ADLs) while encouraging independence whenever possible.
  3. Respond promptly to call lights, bells, intercoms, and resident requests.
  4. Assist with transfers, ambulation, mobility devices, and repositioning.
  5. Support breakfast and lunch services, including meal setup and feeding assistance when needed.
  6. Take and accurately record vital signs, weights, intake/output, and other observations as directed.
  7. Monitor residents for changes in physical, emotional, or cognitive conditions and promptly report concerns to nursing staff.
  8. Provide individualized support to residents with dementia, Alzheimer's disease, or other cognitive impairments.
  9. Accurately document resident care and observations in electronic medical records.
  10. Change bed linens and maintain clean, safe, and organized resident rooms.
  11. Prepare, clean, and properly store care equipment, treatment trays, and supplies.
  12. Assist with resident routines, daily activities, and other assigned care needs.
  13. Communicate respectfully with residents, families, visitors, and coworkers.
  14. Protect resident rights, privacy, safety, and dignity.
  15. Work collaboratively with nursing staff and other departments to maintain quality care.
  16. Perform other duties as assigned.

Qualifications and Requirements

  1. High school diploma or equivalent.
  2. Current Florida Certified Nursing Assistant (CNA) certification required.
  3. Current CPR certification meeting assigned department requirements, including BLS/AED as applicable.
  4. One year of experience in a healthcare or residential care setting preferred; an equivalent combination of training and experience may be considered.
  5. Ability to communicate effectively with residents, families, and healthcare professionals.
  6. Ability to read, understand, and follow care plans, safety procedures, and nursing instructions.
  7. Experience using electronic medical records, preferably PointClickCare.
  8. Basic computer, documentation, and mathematical skills.
  9. Patience and compassion when supporting individuals with cognitive and physical limitations.
  10. Strong teamwork, organization, and problem-solving abilities.

Physical and Environmental Requirements

  1. Ability to stand, walk, bend, lift, and assist residents throughout the shift.
  2. Ability to lift, push, and pull up to 50 pounds.
  3. Ability to assist residents with transfers, mobility, and positioning.
  4. Work is performed primarily indoors in a climate-controlled environment.

Why People Choose Legacy Pointe

Full-time employees receive access to a comprehensive benefits package that includes:

  1. Medical, dental, and vision insurance
  2. Company-paid basic life insurance
  3. Short-term disability options
  4. 401(k) retirement plan
  5. Paid time off that grows with tenure
  6. Eight paid holidays annually
  7. Scholarship programs for employees and dependents
  8. Employee recognition and milestone awards
  9. Employee discounts on attractions, travel, and entertainment
  10. Annual employee appreciation events

Working at Legacy Pointe means being part of a team that values compassion, professionalism, and the meaningful relationships built with residents every day.

Important Notice

Applicants for this position will be required to complete a background screening through the Care Provider Background Screening Clearinghouse, per House Bill 531 (2025).

Learn more:https://info.flclearinghouse.com

Our healthcare team plays an essential role in providing consistent, compassionate care throughout the day and night.

Position Summary

Legacy Pointe at UCF is seeking compassionate and dependable Certified Nursing Assistants (CNAs) for full-time overnight opportunities across Skilled Nursing, Assisted Living, and Memory Care. The overnight CNA provides direct resident care, assists with activities of daily living, responds to resident needs, and helps maintain a safe and comfortable environment throughout the night. This role is especially important in supporting residents who require assistance with nighttime routines, mobility, personal care, and reassurance. CNAs work under the direction of the assigned department's Nurse Manager and nursing team while following established care plans and safety procedures. Candidates may be considered for different departments based on qualifications, experience, preferences, and available positions.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  1. Provide compassionate, person-centered care to residents throughout the overnight shift.
  2. Respond promptly to call lights, bells, intercoms, and resident requests.
  3. Assist residents with toileting, personal hygiene, dressing, and other activities of daily living.
  4. Provide support with nighttime mobility, transfers, ambulation, and repositioning.
  5. Turn and reposition residents as directed to promote comfort and prevent pressure injuries.
  6. Assist residents who awaken during the night and provide reassurance, comfort, and appropriate assistance.
  7. Support residents living with dementia, Alzheimer's disease, or other cognitive impairments using patience and individualized care approaches.
  8. Observe and promptly report changes in residents' physical condition, behavior, or emotional well-being to licensed nursing staff.
  9. Take and record vital signs, intake/output, and other observations as directed.
  10. Document care accurately and in a timely manner using electronic medical records.
  11. Follow established care plans, nursing instructions, infection prevention practices, and safety procedures.
  12. Assist residents with early morning personal care and preparations for the day as assigned.
  13. Change bed linens and maintain clean, comfortable, and organized resident rooms.
  14. Prepare, clean, and properly store care equipment, supplies, and treatment trays.
  15. Maintain resident confidentiality, privacy, safety, and dignity.
  16. Communicate important resident information and observations to nursing staff.
  17. Work collaboratively with coworkers to maintain consistent, high-quality resident care.
  18. Perform additional duties as assigned.

Qualifications and Requirements

  1. High school diploma or equivalent.
  2. Current Florida Certified Nursing Assistant (CNA) certification required.
  3. Current CPR certification meeting assigned department requirements, including BLS/AED as applicable.
  4. One year of experience in a healthcare or residential care setting preferred; an equivalent combination of training and experience may be considered.
  5. Previous overnight experience in Skilled Nursing, Assisted Living, or Memory Care preferred.
  6. Ability to provide compassionate care to residents with varying physical and cognitive needs.
  7. Strong observation, communication, and documentation skills.
  8. Ability to recognize and report changes in resident condition promptly.
  9. Ability to follow individualized care plans, nursing instructions, and safety guidelines.
  10. Familiarity with electronic medical records, preferably PointClickCare.
  11. Basic computer and mathematical skills.
  12. Ability to work independently while remaining an active member of the nursing team.
  13. Dependability, good judgment, and commitment to resident safety.

Physical and Environmental Requirements

  1. Ability to stand, walk, bend, lift, and assist residents throughout the shift.
  2. Ability to lift, push, and pull up to 50 pounds.
  3. Ability to assist with resident transfers, positioning, and mobility.
  4. Work is performed primarily indoors in a climate-controlled healthcare environment.

Work That Makes a Difference

Working at Legacy Pointe is deeply meaningful. Each day brings moments where your presence, patience, and compassion can change someone’s experience for the better. Cook – Position Summary

The Cook is responsible for preparing high-quality, nutritious meals for residents in accordance with established menus, standardized recipes, and individual dietary requirements. This role plays a critical part in resident satisfaction by ensuring meals are prepared safely, served on time, and meet all texture modifications, allergy restrictions, and physician-ordered diets. The Cook adheres to proper food handling, sanitation, and temperature-control standards while maintaining an organized, clean, and efficient kitchen environment. Working collaboratively with the Dietary team, the Cook supports daily meal service, special events, and catering functions while consistently demonstrating professionalism and hospitality aligned with the community’s service excellence philosophy and core values.In addition to food preparation, the Cook is responsible for maintaining compliance with federal, state, and local food safety regulations, including infection control and allergen-handling practices. This position requires effective communication with dietary staff, nursing, and leadership to address resident preferences, intake concerns, equipment needs, and operational issues. The Cook contributes to quality assurance efforts through taste testing, audits, and participation in training and orientation for new team members when assigned. The role involves working in a fast-paced commercial kitchen environment and requires reliability, attention to detail, adaptability, and a genuine interest in serving older adults.

Requirements and Qualifications

  1. High school diploma or GED preferred, with at least one year of cooking experience in healthcare, hospitality, restaurant, or senior living environments preferred
  2. Ability to prepare meals using standardized recipes while following dietary restrictions, texture modifications, allergy protocols, and food safety standards
  3. Knowledge of safe food handling, sanitation practices, temperature controls, and infection prevention procedures
  4. Ability to obtain and maintain required Food Handler certification within established timeframes
  5. Strong attention to detail, organization, and ability to manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced kitchen environment
  6. Effective communication skills and the ability to work respectfully and collaboratively with dietary staff, nursing, leadership, residents, and families
  7. Demonstrated professionalism, reliability, punctuality, and a strong work ethic
  8. Basic math and computer skills to support food preparation, documentation, and electronic dietary systems as applicable
  9. Ability to stand for extended periods, use hands for food preparation, and safely lift or carry items up to 50 pounds
  10. Availability to work weekends, holidays, evenings, and varying shifts as required

Position Summary

The Licensed Practical Nurse (LPN) provides direct nursing care to residents under the direction of nursing leadership and in accordance with applicable nursing regulations and established care plans. Responsibilities include administering medications and treatments, monitoring changes in resident condition, maintaining accurate clinical documentation, and collaborating with healthcare team members to ensure resident safety and quality care. LPNs may work in Skilled Nursing, Assisted Living, or Memory Care depending on qualifications, candidate preferences, and staffing needs. This role requires professionalism, strong clinical skills, effective communication, and a commitment to compassionate, resident-centered care.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  1. Provide direct nursing care in accordance with physician orders, established care plans, and nursing standards.
  2. Administer medications and treatments safely and accurately within the LPN scope of practice.
  3. Monitor residents for changes in physical, emotional, behavioral, and cognitive conditions.
  4. Report significant changes in resident condition to the appropriate nursing staff or healthcare provider.
  5. Take and document vital signs, blood glucose readings, and other clinical observations.
  6. Perform wound care, dressing changes, and other nursing procedures as authorized and assigned.
  7. Maintain accurate and timely clinical documentation using electronic medical records.
  8. Assist with developing, implementing, and updating individualized resident care plans within assigned responsibilities.
  9. Communicate effectively with physicians, residents, families, nursing supervisors, and interdisciplinary team members.
  10. Provide direction and support to Certified Nursing Assistants and other care team members consistent with applicable regulations and departmental procedures.
  11. Respond promptly to resident needs, changes in condition, and emergency situations.
  12. Assist with resident admissions, transfers, and discharges as assigned.
  13. Follow infection prevention, medication safety, and resident safety procedures.
  14. Provide appropriate care and reassurance to residents with dementia, Alzheimer's disease, and other cognitive impairments.
  15. Maintain residents' rights, privacy, dignity, confidentiality, and emotional well-being.
  16. Encourage resident independence while providing appropriate nursing support.
  17. Maintain clean, organized, and properly supplied treatment and nursing areas.
  18. Complete required documentation, training, and other assigned responsibilities.
  19. Perform additional duties as assigned.

Qualifications and Requirements

  1. Graduate of an accredited practical nursing program.
  2. Current, active Florida Licensed Practical Nurse (LPN) license required.
  3. Current CPR/BLS certification required.
  4. Previous experience in Skilled Nursing, Assisted Living, Memory Care, long-term care, or a related healthcare setting preferred.
  5. Knowledge of nursing procedures, medication administration, infection prevention, and resident safety.
  6. Ability to recognize changes in resident condition and respond appropriately.
  7. Strong clinical observation, critical thinking, communication, and organizational skills.
  8. Ability to accurately document care using electronic medical records; PointClickCare experience preferred.
  9. Ability to follow physician orders, established care plans, and nursing procedures.
  10. Strong teamwork and the ability to manage multiple responsibilities in a healthcare environment.
  11. Patience, professionalism, dependability, and compassion when providing care to older adults.

Physical and Environmental Requirements

  1. Ability to stand, walk, bend, and provide hands-on resident care throughout the shift.
  2. Ability to lift, push, and pull up to 50 pounds.
  3. Ability to assist residents with mobility, transfers, and positioning.
  4. Work is performed primarily indoors in a climate-controlled healthcare environment.

RN House Supervisor – Position Summary

The RN House Supervisor oversees nursing staff and daily clinical operations within the Skilled Nursing Facility to ensure safe, high-quality resident care. Reporting to Nurse Leadership, this role coordinates admissions, discharges, and care plans; conducts daily rounds; and ensures accurate documentation and compliance with facility policies, infection control standards, and regulatory requirements. The RN House Supervisor provides leadership support to RNs, LPNs, and CNAs, promotes teamwork and professionalism, and serves as a clinical resource for staff, residents, and families. 

This position is responsible for addressing staffing needs, responding to clinical or operational issues during assigned shifts, and assisting with staff supervision and performance oversight. In the absence of senior nursing leadership, the RN House Supervisor may handle urgent disciplinary matters and ensure continuity of care. The role requires an active Florida RN license, prior nursing leadership experience, strong clinical judgment, effective communication skills, and the ability to manage multiple priorities while working varied shifts, including weekends or holidays as needed.

Qualifications and Requirements

  • Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in the state of Florida (required)
  • Associate’s Degree in Nursing from an accredited college or university (required)
  • Bachelor of Science in Nursing (BSN) preferred
  • Minimum of two (2) years of nursing leadership experience in a Skilled Nursing Facility, Long-Term Care, or Acute Care setting
  • At least two (2) years of supervisory or managerial experience in a healthcare environment
  • Strong knowledge of infection control standards, CMS guidelines, and survey readiness
  • Experience with staff education, training, and competency assessments
  • Certification in Infection Prevention & Control (CIC) preferred or willingness to obtain
  • Strong clinical judgment and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to supervise and support RNs, LPNs, and CNAs
  • Effective verbal and written communication skills
  • Ability to maintain confidentiality and professionalism
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • Proficiency with basic computer systems; PointClickCare (PCC) knowledge preferred
  • Ability to work weekends, holidays, evenings, or varied shifts as needed
  • Physical ability to perform job-related duties in a clinical environment

Job Summary:

The Security Guard is responsible for ensuring the overall safety and security of residents, associates, and their guests by ensuring that only authorized individuals enter the campus. Security Guards work hand in hand with the Health Services Team during emergency response situations. Reports to the Security Supervisor.

Essential Job Functions:

  1. Provide quality customer service in all interactions with residents, guests and staff while maintaining the Rules of Engagement.
  2. Represent the Company through professional demeanor and attitude.
  3. Promptly and kindly greets all residents, guests and employees at the Gate House and around campus.
  4. Monitors residents’ individual Emergency Response System/ Personal Help Button in addition to campus wide surveillance cameras.
  5. Patrols campus and parking areas in an effort to prevent unauthorized parking, potential thefts, vandalism, and ensuring resident safety.
  6. Conducts inspections of campus for safety issues such as roads for potholes, lighting outages on interior & exterior areas and other potential hazards.
  7. Responds to campus emergencies of a medical, criminal, or mechanical nature.
  8. Conducts resident wellness checks by phone and in-person as needed.
  9. Provide reports of calls generated by Emergency Call System to Security Supervisor.
  10. Performs investigation and documentation of incidents including reports of theft, accidents on campus, resident injuries and unauthorized visitors on campus.
  11. Assists Human Resources department with employee terminations as requested.
  12. Adheres to all company policies and procedures.
  13. Attend departmental education and all required in-service training/education.
  14. Maintain confidentiality of resident/family and facility information in accordance with HIPPA regulations.
  15. Respond to all campus fire alarms and assist the fire department in the evacuation of residents when needed.
  16. Cooperate with staff of other departments when needed.
  17. Perform any other duties as required.

Qualifications:

  1. High school diploma or equivalent preferred.
  2. Prior Security experience preferred, but willing to train the right candidate.
  3. CPR, AED & First Aid Certified eligible.
  4. Class D security license preferred.

Critical Skills / Expertise:

  1. Strong customer service skills.
  2. Excellent verbal and written communication skills with attention to detail.
  3. Sound judgment and decision making skills.
  4. Self- directed and requires minimal supervision.
  5. Excellent interpersonal skills.
  6. Able to work well with others, including staff, supervisor, residents, families, volunteers and the public.

Equipment Skills:

  1. Knowledge of windows based applications, Microsoft Excel, Microsoft Word, Internet, and e-mail.
  2. Ability to use and interact effectively on the telephone and voice mail on a multi-line phone.

Physical Requirements:

  1. Required walking, standing, stooping and/or bending for periods of time, climbing ladder or step stool.
  2. Ability to sit or stand for extended time.
  3. Ability to climb stairs, reach overhead.
  4. Ability to lift up to 50 lbs.

Working Conditions:

  1. Busy outdoor and indoor environments.
  2. Exposure to heat and humidity; exposure to cold.

RN - Position Summary

The Registered Nurse (RN) provides direct nursing care to residents in a Skilled Nursing Facility (SNF) under the supervision of the Director of Nursing (DON), Assistant Director of Nursing (ADON), and Nurse Supervisors. This role is responsible for ensuring high-quality resident care, accurate documentation, and compliance with facility policies and state regulations. RNs also supervise Certified Nursing Assistants (CNAs), ensuring effective teamwork and continuity of care. Duties and responsibilities will be completed while demonstrating behaviors that align with our Community’s Service Excellence philosophy and core values.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

The following duties are normal for this position. This list is not to be construed as exclusive or all inclusive. Other duties may be required and assigned.

  • Provide direct nursing care to residents, including medication administration, wound care, and treatments as prescribed.
  • Monitor residents' conditions and report significant changes to the DON, ADON, or  Nurse Supervisors.
  • Supervise CNAs, ensuring proper documentation, adherence to care plans, and assistance with resident needs.
  • Conduct and receive shift reports at the beginning and end of each shift to ensure continuity of care and effective communication.
  • Assist in resident admissions, discharges, and transfers, ensuring accurate documentation and coordination with healthcare providers.
  • Establishes and maintains a close liaison with residents and families.
  • Educate residents and families on care plans, medications, and health conditions as needed.
  • Maintain compliance with all state and federal Skilled Nursing Facility (SNF) regulations.
  • Follow infection control protocols, including proper use of PPE and sanitation procedures.
  • Respond promptly to resident needs, ensuring a compassionate, resident-centered approach to care.
  • Collaborate with physicians, therapists, and social workers to coordinate resident care.
  • Assist with emergency response procedures and provide first aid or CPR as necessary.
  • Document resident care accurately using electronic medical records (EMR) on facility-approved computers, tablets, or iPads.
  • Assists with ongoing care management meetings.
  • Support quality assurance initiatives and participate in performance improvement programs.
  • Work as part of a team, assisting fellow nurses and CNAs when needed to maintain smooth operations.
  • Perform other duties as assigned by the nursing leadership team.

Supervisory Responsibilities:

  • Oversee CNAs to ensure proper resident care and documentation.
  • Assist with training and mentoring new CNAs.
  • Address performance concerns and escalate issues to the DON as necessary.
  • Ensure CNAs follow resident care plans and facility protocols.

Qualifications:

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and abilities required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Educational Requirements and Experience:

  • Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in Florida (Required).
  • CPR/AED certification required.
  • Experience in long-term care or skilled nursing preferred but not required.
  • Familiarity with Skilled Nursing Facility (SNF) regulations and compliance standards preferred.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

Language Ability:

  • Ability to communicate effectively in writing and verbally, speaking the primary language of the residents.
  • Ability to read and interpret documents such as safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions, and procedure manuals.
  • Ability to write routine reports and correspondence.
  • Ability to speak effectively before groups of customers or employees of organization.

Mathematical Skills:

  • Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide in all units of measure, using whole numbers, common fractions, and decimals. Ability to compute rate, ratio, and percent, and to draw and interpret graphs.

Interpersonal Skills:

  • Ability to work in a polite, respectful, caring, calm, and compassionate way

Ability to Handle Confidential Information:

  • Must be a trustworthy individual who can keep items confidential as appropriate

Computer Skills:

  • Proficiency in using computers, tablets, or iPads for recording vital signs, charting, and reviewing resident care plans.
  • Basic typing skills to ensure efficient and accurate data entry.
  • Ability to use the Internet.

Problem-Solving & Adaptability:

  • Ability to apply common sense understanding to carry out instructions furnished in written, oral, or diagram form.  
  • Ability to deal with problems involving several concrete variables in standardized situations.

Competencies:

  • Must demonstrate an interest in working with a senior cognitive impaired population.
  • Provides leadership by exhibiting confidence in self and others; Inspires and motivates others to perform well.
  • Interacts with guests, residents and staff in a courteous and friendly manner.
  • Responds promptly to resident and visitor needs and assistance.
  • Supports organization's goals and values.
  • Balances team and individual responsibilities. Manages people effectively by taking responsibility for subordinates' activities; Makes self-available to staff; Provides regular performance feedback; Develops subordinates' skills and encourages growth; Improves processes, products and services.
  • Provides leadership by exhibiting confidence in self and others; Inspires and motivates others to perform well.

Environmental Adaptability:

  • Works primarily indoors in a climate-controlled setting
